text.en: Items: a. Spindle assemblies, consisting of spindles and bearings as a minimal assembly, with radial (“run out”) or axial (“camming”) axis motion in one revolution of the spindle less (better) than 0.0006 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

text.zh: b. 具有以下全部特性的单点金刚石切削刀片：
text.en: b. Single point diamond cutting tool inserts, having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 切削刃在任何方向放大400倍观察时均无缺陷、无崩口；
text.en: b.1. Flawless and chip-free cutting edge when magnified 400 times in any direction;

text.zh: b.2. 切削半径为0.1至5 mm（包括端点）；且
text.en: b.2. Cutting radius from 0.1 to 5 mm inclusive; and

text.zh: b.3. 切削半径的不圆度小于（优于）0.002 mm TIR。
text.en: b.3. Cutting radius out-of-roundness less (better) than 0.002 mm TIR.

text.zh: c. “专门设计”、安装有“零件”或“部件”的印刷电路板，按制造商规格，能够将“数控”单元、机床或反馈装置升级至达到或超过ECCN 2B991、2B993、2B996、2B997或2B998所规定的水平。
text.en: c. “Specially designed” printed circuit boards with mounted “parts” or “components” capable of upgrading, according to the manufacturer's specifications, “numerical control” units, machine tools or feed-back devices to or above the levels specified in ECCNs 2B991, 2B993, 2B996, 2B997, or 2B998.

text.en: Related Controls: (1) “Software” “required” for the “development,” “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.5 milliradian (a lower milliradian number means a more accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) “Software” “required” for the “development”, “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian spatial resolution (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is designated as EAR99. (3) See ECCNs 2A984 and 2E984 for related commodity and technology controls.

text.zh: 物项：a. 提供“自适应控制”且同时具有以下两项特性的“软件”：
text.en: Items: a. “Software” to provide “adaptive control” and having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 用于“柔性制造单元”（FMU），该单元至少由EAR Part 772中“柔性制造单元”定义b.1及b.2所述设备构成；且
text.en: a.1. For “flexible manufacturing units” (FMUs) which consist at least of equipment described in b.1 and b.2 of the definition of “flexible manufacturing unit” contained in part 772 of the EAR; and

text.zh: a.2. 能利用至少两种检测技术同时获取的信号，在“实时处理”中生成或修改程序或数据，例如：
text.en: a.2. Capable of generating or modifying, in “real-time processing”, programs or data by using the signals obtained simultaneously by means of at least two detection techniques, such as:

text.zh: a.2.a. 机器视觉（光学测距）；
text.en: a.2.a. Machine vision (optical ranging);

text.zh: a.2.b. 红外成像；
text.en: a.2.b. Infrared imaging;

text.zh: a.2.c. 声学成像（声学测距）；
text.en: a.2.c. Acoustical imaging (acoustical ranging);

text.zh: a.2.d. 触觉测量；
text.en: a.2.d. Tactile measurement;

text.zh: a.2.e. 惯性定位；
text.en: a.2.e. Inertial positioning;

text.zh: a.2.f. 力测量；且
text.en: a.2.f. Force measurement; and

text.zh: a.2.g. 扭矩测量。
text.en: a.2.g. Torque measurement.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 2D992.a不管制仅利用预存零件程序和预存零件程序分配策略，对“柔性制造单元”内功能相同设备重新排程的“软件”。
text.en: 2D992.a does not control “software” which only provides rescheduling of functionally identical equipment within “flexible manufacturing units” using pre-stored part programs and a pre-stored strategy for the distribution of the part programs.

text.en: b. Reserved.

text.zh: 沉积技术表注释 1. “涂覆工艺”包括涂层修复和翻新，以及初次涂覆。
text.en: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 2. “合金化铝化物涂层”包括在施加铝化物涂层之前或期间沉积一种或多种元素的单步骤或多步骤涂层，即使这些元素通过另一种涂覆工艺沉积。但不包括多次使用单步骤包埋渗工艺以获得合金化铝化物的情况。
text.en: 2. The term 'alloyed aluminide coating' includes single or multiple-step coatings in which an element or elements are deposited prior to or during application of the aluminide coating, even if these elements are deposited by another coating process. It does not, however, include the multiple use of single-step pack cementation processes to achieve alloyed aluminides.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 3. “贵金属改性铝化物”涂层包括在施加铝化物涂层之前，通过其他涂覆工艺先沉积一种或多种贵金属的多步骤涂层。
text.en: 3. The term 'noble metal modified aluminide' coating includes multiple-step coatings in which the noble metal or noble metals are laid down by some other coating process prior to application of the aluminide coating.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 4. “其混合物”包括通过表中一种或多种涂覆工艺获得的渗透材料、梯度组成、共沉积层及多层沉积层。
text.en: 4. The term 'mixtures thereof' includes infiltrated material, graded compositions, co-deposits and multilayer deposits and are obtained by one or more of the coating processes specified in the Table.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 5. MCrAlX指一种涂层合金，其中M为钴、铁、镍或其组合；X为任意含量的铪、钇、硅、钽，或按重量计超过0.01%的其他有意添加元素，以不同比例和组合存在，但下列除外：
text.en: 5. MCrAlX refers to a coating alloy where M equals cobalt, iron, nickel or combinations thereof and X equals hafnium, yttrium, silicon, tantalum in any amount or other intentional additions over 0.01% by weight in various proportions and combinations, except:

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: a. 按重量计铬含量低于22%、铝含量低于7%且钇含量低于2%的CoCrAlY涂层；
text.en: a. CoCrAlY coatings which contain less than 22% by weight of chromium, less than 7% by weight of aluminum and less than 2% by weight of yttrium;

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: b. 按重量计铬含量为22至24%、铝含量为10至12%且钇含量为0.5至0.7%的CoCrAlY涂层；或
text.en: b. CoCrAlY coatings which contain 22 to 24% by weight of chromium, 10 to 12% by weight of aluminum and 0.5 to 0.7% by weight of yttrium; or

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: c. 按重量计铬含量为21至23%、铝含量为10至12%且钇含量为0.9至1.1%的NiCrAlY涂层。
text.en: c. NiCrAlY coatings which contain 21 to 23% by weight of chromium, 10 to 12% by weight of aluminum and 0.9 to 1.1% by weight of yttrium.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 6. “铝合金”指在293 K（20 °C）下测得极限抗拉强度为190 MPa或以上的合金。
text.en: 6. The term 'aluminum alloys' refers to alloys having an ultimate tensile strength of 190 MPa or more measured at 293 K (20 °C).

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 7. “耐蚀钢”指AISI（美国钢铁协会）300系列钢或符合等同国家标准的钢。
text.en: 7. The term 'corrosion resistant steel' refers to AISI (American Iron and Steel Institute) 300 series or equivalent national standard steels.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 8. “难熔金属及合金”包括以下金属及其合金：铌、钼、钨和钽。
text.en: 8. 'Refractory metals and alloys' include the following metals and their alloys: niobium (columbium), molybdenum, tungsten and tantalum.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 9. “传感器窗口材料”如下：氧化铝、硅、锗、硫化锌、硒化锌、砷化镓、金刚石、磷化镓、蓝宝石，以及以下金属卤化物：直径大于40 mm的氟化锆和氟化铪传感器窗口材料。
text.en: 9. 'Sensor window materials', as follows: alumina, silicon, germanium, zinc sulfide, zinc selenide, gallium arsenide, diamond, gallium phosphide, sapphire and the following metal halides: sensor window materials of more than 40 mm diameter for zirconium fluoride and hafnium fluoride.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 10. 第2类不包括实心翼型件的单步骤包埋渗“技术”。
text.en: 10. Category 2 does not include “technology” for single-step pack cementation of solid airfoils.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 11. “聚合物”如下：聚酰亚胺、聚酯、聚硫化物、聚碳酸酯和聚氨酯。
text.en: 11. 'Polymers', as follows: Polyimide, polyester, polysulfide, polycarbonates and polyurethanes.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 12. “改性氧化锆”指为稳定某些晶相及相组成，向氧化锆中添加其他金属氧化物（例如氧化钙、氧化镁、氧化钇、氧化铪、稀土氧化物）。由通过混合或熔融方式以氧化钙或氧化镁改性的氧化锆制成的热障涂层不受管制。
text.en: 12. 'Modified zirconia' refers to additions of other metal oxides, (e.g., calcia, magnesia, yttria, hafnia, rare earth oxides) to zirconia in order to stabilize certain crystallographic phases and phase compositions. Thermal barrier coatings made of zirconia, modified with calcia or magnesia by mixing or fusion, are not controlled.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 13. “钛合金”仅指在293 K（20 °C）下测得极限抗拉强度为900 MPa或以上的航空航天合金。
text.en: 13. 'Titanium alloys' refers only to aerospace alloys having an ultimate tensile strength of 900 MPa or more measured at 293 K (20 °C).

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 14. “低膨胀玻璃”指在293 K（20 °C）下测得热膨胀系数为1 × 10^{−7} K^{−1}或以下的玻璃。
text.en: 14. 'Low-expansion glasses' refers to glasses which have a coefficient of thermal expansion of 1 × 10^{−7} K^{−1} or less measured at 293 K (20 °C).

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 15. “介质层”是由多层绝缘材料构成的涂层，利用由不同折射率材料构成的设计的干涉特性，反射、透射或吸收不同波段。“介质层”指四层以上介质层或介质/金属“复合”层。
text.en: 15. 'Dielectric layers' are coatings constructed of multi-layers of insulator materials in which the interference properties of a design composed of materials of various refractive indices are used to reflect, transmit or absorb various wavelength bands. Dielectric layers refers to more than four dielectric layers or dielectric/metal “composite” layers.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 16. “硬质碳化钨”不包括由碳化钨/（钴、镍）、碳化钛/（钴、镍）、碳化铬/镍铬及碳化铬/镍构成的切削和成形工具材料。
text.en: 16. 'Cemented tungsten carbide' does not include cutting and forming tool materials consisting of tungsten carbide/(cobalt, nickel), titanium carbide/(cobalt, nickel), chromium carbide/nickel-chromium and chromium carbide/nickel.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 17. 在以下任一物项上沉积类金刚石碳的“技术”不受管制：磁盘驱动器及磁头、一次性用品制造设备、水龙头阀、扬声器声学振膜、汽车发动机零件、切削刀具、冲压模具、办公自动化设备、麦克风、医疗器械，或由铍含量低于5%的合金制成、用于塑料浇铸或模塑的模具。
text.en: 17. “Technology” for depositing diamond-like carbon on any of the following is not controlled: magnetic disk drives and heads, equipment for the manufacture of disposables, valves for faucets, acoustic diaphragms for speakers, engine parts for automobiles, cutting tools, punching-pressing dies, office automation equipment, microphones, medical devices or molds, for casting or molding of plastics, manufactured from alloys containing less than 5% beryllium.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 18. “碳化硅”不包括切削和成形工具材料。
text.en: 18. 'Silicon carbide' does not include cutting and forming tool materials.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 19. 本条目所称陶瓷基材，不包括黏土或水泥含量按重量计达到5%或以上的陶瓷材料，无论黏土和水泥单独存在还是组合存在。
text.en: 19. Ceramic substrates, as used in this entry, does not include ceramic materials containing 5% by weight, or greater, clay or cement content, either as separate constituents or in combination.

blocks.noteHeading: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

text.zh: 沉积技术表技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 表中第1列所列工艺定义如下：
text.en: Processes specified in Column 1 of the Table are defined as follows:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: a. 化学气相沉积（CVD）是一种覆盖涂层或表面改性涂层工艺，将金属、合金、“复合材料”、介质或陶瓷沉积于加热的基材上。气态反应物在基材附近分解或化合，使所需元素、合金或化合物材料沉积于基材。该分解或化学反应过程的能量可由基材热量、辉光放电等离子体或“激光”照射提供。
text.en: a. Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) is an overlay coating or surface modification coating process wherein a metal, alloy, “composite”, dielectric or ceramic is deposited upon a heated substrate. Gaseous reactants are decomposed or combined in the vicinity of a substrate resulting in the deposition of the desired elemental, alloy or compound material on the substrate. Energy for this decomposition or chemical reaction process may be provided by the heat of the substrate, a glow discharge plasma, or “laser” irradiation.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注1：CVD包括以下工艺：定向气流非包埋沉积、脉冲CVD、受控成核热分解（CNTD）、等离子体增强或等离子体辅助CVD。
text.en: Note 1: CVD includes the following processes: Directed gas flow out-of-pack deposition, pulsating CVD, controlled nucleation thermal decomposition (CNTD), plasma enhanced or plasma assisted CVD processes.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注2：包埋指基材浸埋于粉末混合物中。
text.en: Note 2: Pack denotes a substrate immersed in a powder mixture.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注3：非包埋工艺所用气态反应物采用与包埋渗工艺相同的基本反应及参数生成，区别在于待涂覆基材不与粉末混合物接触。
text.en: Note 3: The gaseous reactants used in the out-of-pack process are produced using the same basic reactions and parameters as the pack cementation process, except that the substrate to be coated is not in contact with the powder mixture.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: b. 热蒸发-物理气相沉积（TE-PVD）是在压力小于0.1 Pa的真空中进行的覆盖涂层工艺，利用热能源将涂层材料汽化。蒸发物随后在适当放置的基材上冷凝或沉积。在涂覆过程中向真空室加入气体以合成化合物涂层，是该工艺的常见改进。采用离子束、电子束或等离子体激活或辅助涂层沉积，也是该技术的常见改进。这些工艺可具有利用监测器在过程中测量涂层光学特性和厚度的功能。具体TE-PVD工艺如下：
text.en: b. Thermal Evaporation-Physical Vapor Deposition (TE-PVD) is an overlay coating process conducted in a vacuum with a pressure less than 0.1 Pa wherein a source of thermal energy is used to vaporize the coating material. This process results in the condensation, or deposition, of the evaporated species onto appropriately positioned substrates. The addition of gases to the vacuum chamber during the coating process to synthesize compound coatings is an ordinary modification of the process. The use of ion or electron beams, or plasma, to activate or assist the coating's deposition is also a common modification in this technique. The use of monitors to provide in-process measurement of optical characteristics and thickness of coatings can be a feature of these processes. Specific TE-PVD processes are as follows:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 1. 电子束PVD利用电子束加热并蒸发形成涂层的材料；
text.en: 1. Electron Beam PVD uses an electron beam to heat and evaporate the material which forms the coating;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 2. 离子辅助电阻加热PVD将电阻热源与入射离子束结合，产生受控、均匀的蒸发涂层物质通量；
text.en: 2. Ion Assisted Resistive Heating PVD employs electrically resistive heating sources in combination with impinging ion beam(s) to produce a controlled and uniform flux of evaporated coating species;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 3. “激光”汽化利用脉冲或连续波“激光”束，使形成涂层的材料汽化；
text.en: 3. “Laser” Vaporization uses either pulsed or continuous wave “laser” beams to vaporize the material which forms the coating;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 4. 阴极电弧沉积采用由涂层材料制成的消耗性阴极，通过接地触发器的瞬时接触，在其表面建立电弧放电。受控的电弧运动侵蚀阴极表面，产生高度电离的等离子体。阳极可以是通过绝缘体连接于阴极外围的锥体，也可以是腔体。非视线沉积采用基材偏压；
text.en: 4. Cathodic Arc Deposition employs a consumable cathode of the material which forms the coating and has an arc discharge established on the surface by a momentary contact of a ground trigger. Controlled motion of arcing erodes the cathode surface creating a highly ionized plasma. The anode can be either a cone attached to the periphery of the cathode, through an insulator, or the chamber. Substrate biasing is used for non line-of-sight deposition;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注：该定义不包括对未施加偏压基材进行的随机阴极电弧沉积。
text.en: Note: This definition does not include random cathodic arc deposition with non-biased substrates.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 5. 离子镀是一般TE-PVD工艺的一种特殊改进，利用等离子体或离子源使待沉积物质电离，并对基材施加负偏压，以便从等离子体中引出该物质。引入反应性物质、在工艺腔内蒸发固体，以及使用监测器在过程中测量涂层光学特性和厚度，均为该工艺的常见改进。
text.en: 5. Ion Plating is a special modification of a general TE-PVD process in which a plasma or an ion source is used to ionize the species to be deposited, and a negative bias is applied to the substrate in order to facilitate the extraction of the species from the plasma. The introduction of reactive species, evaporation of solids within the process chamber, and the use of monitors to provide in-process measurement of optical characteristics and thicknesses of coatings are ordinary modifications of the process.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: c. 包埋渗是一种表面改性涂层或覆盖涂层工艺，将基材浸埋于由以下成分构成的粉末混合物（包埋料）中：
text.en: c. Pack Cementation is a surface modification coating or overlay coating process wherein a substrate is immersed in a powder mixture (a pack), that consists of:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 1. 待沉积的金属粉末（通常为铝、铬、硅或其组合）；
text.en: 1. The metallic powders that are to be deposited (usually aluminum, chromium, silicon or combinations thereof);

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 2. 活化剂（通常为卤化物盐）；且
text.en: 2. An activator (normally a halide salt); and

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 3. 惰性粉末，最常用的是氧化铝。
text.en: 3. An inert powder, most frequently alumina.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注：基材与粉末混合物置于反应罐内，加热至1,030 K（757 °C）至1,375 K（1,102 °C）之间，并保持足够时间以沉积涂层。
text.en: Note: The substrate and powder mixture is contained within a retort which is heated to between 1,030 K (757 °C) to 1,375 K (1,102 °C) for sufficient time to deposit the coating.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: d. 等离子体喷涂是一种覆盖涂层工艺，产生并控制等离子体的喷枪接受粉末或丝状涂层材料，将其熔化并推向基材，在基材上形成整体结合的涂层。等离子体喷涂包括低压等离子体喷涂或高速等离子体喷涂。
text.en: d. Plasma Spraying is an overlay coating process wherein a gun (spray torch) which produces and controls a plasma accepts powder or wire coating materials, melts them and propels them towards a substrate, whereon an integrally bonded coating is formed. Plasma spraying constitutes either low pressure plasma spraying or high velocity plasma spraying.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: >注1：低压指低于环境大气压力。
text.en: >Note 1: Low pressure means less than ambient atmospheric pressure.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注2：高速指按293 K（20 °C）、0.1 MPa条件计算，喷嘴出口气体速度超过750 m/s。
text.en: Note 2: High velocity refers to nozzle-exit gas velocity exceeding 750 m/s calculated at 293 K (20 °C) at 0.1 MPa.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: e. 浆料沉积是一种表面改性涂层或覆盖涂层工艺，将含有机黏结剂的金属或陶瓷粉末悬浮于液体中，通过喷涂、浸涂或刷涂施加于基材，随后风干或烘干，并经热处理获得所需涂层。
text.en: e. Slurry Deposition is a surface modification coating or overlay coating process wherein a metallic or ceramic powder with an organic binder is suspended in a liquid and is applied to a substrate by either spraying, dipping or painting, subsequent air or oven drying, and heat treatment to obtain the desired coating.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: f. 溅射沉积是一种基于动量传递现象的覆盖涂层工艺，正离子经电场加速后射向靶材（涂层材料）表面。入射离子的动能足以使靶材表面原子逸出，并沉积于适当放置的基材上。
text.en: f. Sputter Deposition is an overlay coating process based on a momentum transfer phenomenon, wherein positive ions are accelerated by an electric field towards the surface of a target (coating material). The kinetic energy of the impacting ions is sufficient to cause target surface atoms to be released and deposited on an appropriately positioned substrate.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注1：本表仅涉及用于提高涂层附着力和沉积速率的三极、磁控或反应溅射沉积，以及用于使非金属涂层材料汽化的射频（RF）增强溅射沉积。
text.en: Note 1: The Table refers only to triode, magnetron or reactive sputter deposition which is used to increase adhesion of the coating and rate of deposition and to radio frequency (RF) augmented sputter deposition used to permit vaporization of non-metallic coating materials.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: 注2：可使用低能离子束（小于5 keV）激活沉积。
text.en: Note 2: Low-energy ion beams (less than 5 keV) can be used to activate the deposition.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

text.zh: g. 离子注入是一种表面改性涂层工艺，将待合金化的元素电离，经电位梯度加速并注入基材表面区域。包括离子注入与电子束物理气相沉积或溅射沉积同步进行的工艺。
text.en: g. Ion Implantation is a surface modification coating process in which the element to be alloyed is ionized, accelerated through a potential gradient and implanted into the surface region of the substrate. This includes processes in which ion implantation is performed simultaneously with electron beam physical vapor deposition or sputter deposition.

text.zh: 相关管制：（1）为“开发”、“生产”或“使用”工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率小于0.5毫弧度（毫弧度数值越小，图像分辨率越精确）的隐蔽物体探测设备所“必需”的“技术”，或为“开发”此类工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率小于0.5毫弧度的隐蔽物体探测设备的“开发”、“生产”或“使用”所“必需”的“软件”而“必需”的“技术”，均“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR Parts 120至130）。（2）为“开发”、“生产”或“使用”工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率大于1毫弧度（毫弧度数值越大，图像分辨率越低）的隐蔽物体探测设备所“必需”的“技术”，或为“开发”此类工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率大于1毫弧度（毫弧度数值越大，图像分辨率越低）的隐蔽物体探测设备的“开发”、“生产”或“使用”所“必需”的“软件”而“必需”的“技术”，均归为EAR99。（3）相关商品和软件管制见ECCN 2A984和2D984。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) “Technology” “required” for the “development,” “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.5 milliradian (a lower milliradian number means a more accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters or “required” for the “development” of “software” “required” for the “development,” “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.5 milliradian at a standoff distance of 100 meters is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) “Technology” “required” for the “development”, “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian spatial resolution (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters or “required” for the “development” of “software” “required” for the “development”, “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian spatial resolution (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is designated as EAR99. (3) See ECCNs 2A984 and 2D984 for related commodity and software controls.

text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：（1）某些“空间合格”电子设备见USML第XV类；某些“受ITAR管辖”的ASIC、“发射/接收模块”、“发射模块”或“MMIC”见USML第XI类。（2）另见3A090、3A101、3A201、3A611，以及3A901中不受3A001、3A991和9A515管制的低温CMOS集成电路、参量信号放大器或量子极限放大器。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See Category XV of the USML for certain “space-qualified” electronics and Category XI of the USML for certain ASICs, 'transmit/receive modules,' 'transmit modules,' or 'MMICs' “subject to the ITAR.” (2) See also 3A090, 3A101, 3A201, 3A611, 3A901 for cryogenic CMOS integrated circuits and parametric signal amplifiers or quantum limited amplifiers not controlled by 3A001, 3A991, and 9A515.

text.zh: 相关定义：“微电路”指多个无源或有源元件在连续结构表面或内部不可分割地关联，以执行电路功能的装置。就3A001.a.1中的集成电路而言，5 × 10^{3} Gy(Si) = 5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si)；5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/s = 5 × 10^{8} Rads (Si)/s。
text.en: Related Definitions: 'Microcircuit' means a device in which a number of passive or active elements are considered as indivisibly associated on or within a continuous structure to perform the function of a circuit. For the purposes of integrated circuits in 3A001.a.1, 5 × 10^{3} Gy(Si) = 5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si); 5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/s = 5 × 10^{8} Rads (Si)/s.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 如下通用集成电路：
text.en: a. General purpose integrated circuits, as follows:
Note 1:

text.zh: 集成电路包括以下类型：
text.en: Integrated circuits include the following types:

text.zh: —“单片集成电路”；
text.en: —“Monolithic integrated circuits”;

text.zh: —“混合集成电路”；
text.en: —“Hybrid integrated circuits”;

text.zh: —“多芯片集成电路”；
text.en: —“Multichip integrated circuits”;

text.zh: —“薄膜型集成电路”，包括蓝宝石上硅集成电路；
text.en: —“Film type integrated circuits”, including silicon-on-sapphire integrated circuits;

text.zh: —“光集成电路”；
text.en: —“Optical integrated circuits”;

text.zh: —“三维集成电路”；
text.en: —“Three dimensional integrated circuits”;

text.zh: —“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）。
text.en: —“Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits” (“MMICs”).

text.zh: a.1. 设计或额定为抗辐射型，能够承受以下任一条件的集成电路：
text.en: a.1. Integrated circuits designed or rated as radiation hardened to withstand any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a. 总剂量5 × 10^{3} Gy（Si）或以上；
text.en: a.1.a. A total dose of 5 × 10^{3} Gy (Si), or higher;

text.zh: a.1.b. 剂量率扰乱阈值5 × 10^{6} Gy（Si）/s或以上；或
text.en: a.1.b. A dose rate upset of 5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/s, or higher; or

text.zh: a.1.c. 对硅材料，中子（1 MeV等效）注量（积分通量）为5 × 10^{13} n/cm^{2}或以上，或对其他材料的等效值；
text.en: a.1.c. A fluence (integrated flux) of neutrons (1 MeV equivalent) of 5 × 10^{13} n/cm^{2} or higher on silicon, or its equivalent for other materials;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.a.1.c不适用于金属-绝缘体-半导体（MIS）。
text.en: 3A001.a.1.c does not apply to Metal Insulator Semiconductors (MIS).

text.zh: a.2. 具有以下任一特性的“微处理器微电路”、“微计算机微电路”、微控制器微电路、采用化合物半导体制造的存储集成电路、模数转换器、含模数转换器并存储或处理数字化数据的集成电路、数模转换器、设计用于“信号处理”的电光或“光集成电路”、现场可编程逻辑器件、功能未知或其将用于的设备管制状态未知的定制集成电路、快速傅里叶变换（FFT）处理器、静态随机存取存储器（SRAM）或“非易失性存储器”：
text.en: a.2. “Microprocessor microcircuits,” “microcomputer microcircuits,” microcontroller microcircuits, storage integrated circuits manufactured from a compound semiconductor, analog-to-digital converters, integrated circuits that contain analog-to-digital converters and store or process the digitized data, digital-to-analog converters, electro-optical or “optical integrated circuits” designed for “signal processing”, field programmable logic devices, custom integrated circuits for which either the function is unknown or the control status of the equipment in which the integrated circuit will be used in unknown, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) processors, Static Random-Access Memories (SRAMs), or 'non-volatile memories,' having any of the following:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.a.2而言，“非易失性存储器”指断电后仍可在一段时间内保留数据的存储器。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.2, 'non-volatile memories' are memories with data retention over a period of time after a power shutdown.

text.zh: a.2.a. 额定可在高于398 K（+125 °C）的环境温度下工作；
text.en: a.2.a. Rated for operation at an ambient temperature above 398 K (+125 °C);

text.zh: a.2.b. 额定可在低于218 K（−55 °C）的环境温度下工作；或
text.en: a.2.b. Rated for operation at an ambient temperature below 218 K (−55 °C); or

text.zh: a.2.c. 额定可在218 K（−55 °C）至398 K（+125 °C）的整个环境温度范围内工作；
text.en: a.2.c. Rated for operation over the entire ambient temperature range from 218 K (−55 °C) to 398 K (+125 °C);

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 3A001.a.2未列明的低温CMOS集成电路见3A901.a。
text.en: For cryogenic CMOS integrated circuits not specified by 3A001.a.2, see 3A901.a.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.a.2不适用于为民用汽车或铁路列车用途设计的集成电路。
text.en: 3A001.a.2 does not apply to integrated circuits designed for civil automobile or railway train applications.

text.zh: a.3. 由化合物半导体制造，工作时钟频率超过40 MHz的“微处理器微电路”、“微计算机微电路”和微控制器微电路；
text.en: a.3. “Microprocessor microcircuits”, “microcomputer microcircuits” and microcontroller microcircuits, manufactured from a compound semiconductor and operating at a clock frequency exceeding 40 MHz;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.a.3包括数字信号处理器、数字阵列处理器及数字协处理器。
text.en: 3A001.a.3 includes digital signal processors, digital array processors and digital coprocessors.
a.4. [Reserved]

text.zh: a.5. 如下模数转换器（ADC）和数模转换器（DAC）集成电路：
text.en: a.5. Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) and Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) integrated circuits, as follows:

text.zh: a.5.a. 具有以下任一特性的ADC：
text.en: a.5.a. ADCs having any of the following:

text.zh: a.5.a.1. 分辨率为8 bit或以上但小于10 bit，“采样率”大于1.3吉样本/秒（GSPS）；
text.en: a.5.a.1. A resolution of 8 bit or more, but less than 10 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.3 Giga Samples Per Second (GSPS);

text.zh: a.5.a.2. 分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit，“采样率”大于600兆样本/秒（MSPS）；
text.en: a.5.a.2. A resolution of 10 bit or more, but less than 12 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 600 Mega Samples Per Second (MSPS);

text.zh: a.5.a.3. 分辨率为12 bit或以上但小于14 bit，“采样率”大于400 MSPS；
text.en: a.5.a.3. A resolution of 12 bit or more, but less than 14 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 400 MSPS;

text.zh: a.5.a.4. 分辨率为14 bit或以上但小于16 bit，“采样率”大于250 MSPS；或
text.en: a.5.a.4. A resolution of 14 bit or more, but less than 16 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 250 MSPS; or

text.zh: a.5.a.5. 分辨率为16 bit或以上，“采样率”大于65 MSPS；
text.en: a.5.a.5. A resolution of 16 bit or more with a “sample rate” greater than 65 MSPS;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 含模数转换器且存储或处理数字化数据的集成电路见3A001.a.14。
text.en: For integrated circuits that contain analog-to-digital converters and store or process the digitized data see 3A001.a.14.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3A001.a.5.a而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.5.a:

text.zh: 1. n bit分辨率对应2^{n}个量化等级。
text.en: 1. A resolution of n bit corresponds to a quantization of 2^{n} levels.

text.zh: 2. ADC的分辨率是表示被测模拟输入的数字输出位数。有效位数（ENOB）不用于确定ADC分辨率。
text.en: 2. The resolution of the ADC is the number of bits of the digital output that represents the measured analog input. Effective Number of Bits (ENOB) is not used to determine the resolution of the ADC.

text.zh: 3. 对于“多通道ADC”，“采样率”不累加，以任一单通道的最大速率为“采样率”。
text.en: 3. For “multiple channel ADCs”, the “sample rate” is not aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum rate of any single channel.

text.zh: 4. 对于“交织ADC”或规定具有交织工作模式的“多通道ADC”，各“采样率”累加，以所有交织通道合计的最大总速率为“采样率”。
text.en: 4. For “interleaved ADCs” or for “multiple channel ADCs” that are specified to have an interleaved mode of operation, the “sample rates” are aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum combined total rate of all of the interleaved channels.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3A001.a.5.b而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.5.b:

text.zh: 1. “无杂散动态范围”（SFDR）定义为DAC输入端载波频率（最大信号分量）的均方根值与输出端次大噪声或谐波失真分量均方根值之比。
text.en: 1. 'Spurious Free Dynamic Range' (SFDR) is defined as the ratio of the RMS value of the carrier frequency (maximum signal component) at the input of the DAC to the RMS value of the next largest noise or harmonic distortion component at its output.

text.zh: 2. SFDR直接根据规格表或SFDR随频率变化的特性曲线确定。
text.en: 2. SFDR is determined directly from the specification table or from the characterization plots of SFDR versus frequency.

text.zh: 3. 信号幅度大于−3 dBfs（满量程）时，定义为满量程信号。
text.en: 3. A signal is defined to be full scale when its amplitude is greater than −3 dBfs (full scale).

text.zh: 4. DAC的“调整后更新率”为：
text.en: 4. 'Adjusted update rate' for DACs is:

text.zh: a. 对于常规（非插值）DAC，“调整后更新率”是数字信号转换为模拟信号且DAC输出模拟值发生变化的速率。对于可旁路插值模式（插值因子为一）的DAC，应视为常规（非插值）DAC。
text.en: a. For conventional (non-interpolating) DACs, the 'adjusted update rate' is the rate at which the digital signal is converted to an analog signal and the output analog values are changed by the DAC. For DACs where the interpolation mode may be bypassed (interpolation factor of one), the DAC should be considered as a conventional (non-interpolating) DAC.

text.zh: b. 对于插值DAC（过采样DAC），“调整后更新率”定义为DAC更新率除以最小插值因子。对于插值DAC，“调整后更新率”可能采用不同名称，包括：
text.en: b. For interpolating DACs (oversampling DACs), the 'adjusted update rate' is defined as the DAC update rate divided by the smallest interpolating factor. For interpolating DACs, the 'adjusted update rate' may be referred to by different terms including:

text.zh: • 输入数据率
text.en: • input data rate

text.zh: • 输入字速率
text.en: • input word rate

text.zh: • 输入采样率
text.en: • input sample rate

text.zh: • 最大总输入总线速率
text.en: • maximum total input bus rate

text.zh: • DAC时钟输入的最大DAC时钟速率
text.en: • maximum DAC clock rate for DAC clock input

text.zh: b.2.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于40 W（46 dBm）；或
text.en: b.2.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 40 W (46 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: b.2.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 W（43 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 W (43 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过16 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.2.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 16 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.2.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 W（40 dBm）；或
text.en: b.2.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 10 W (40 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz; or

text.zh: b.2.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于5 W（37 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 5 W (37 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 16 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.c. 额定在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于3 W（34.77 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.2.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 3 W (34.77 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.2.d. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.e. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于1 W（30 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.2.e. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 1 W (30 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.2.f. 额定在大于43.5 GHz且不超过75 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于31.62 mW（15 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.2.f. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 31.62 mW (15 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz up to and including 75 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.2.g. 额定在大于75 GHz且不超过90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 mW（10 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于5%；或
text.en: b.2.g. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 10 mW (10 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 75 GHz up to and including 90 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 5%; or

text.zh: b.2.h. 额定在大于90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.h. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 90 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: [保留]
text.en: [Reserved]
Note 2:

text.zh: 如“MMIC”的额定工作频率跨越3A001.b.2.a至3A001.b.2.h所定义的多个频率范围，其管制状态按最低峰值饱和输出功率管制阈值确定。
text.en: The control status of the “MMIC” whose rated operating frequency includes frequencies listed in more than one frequency range, as defined by 3A001.b.2.a through 3A001.b.2.h, is determined by the lowest peak saturated power output control threshold.
Note 3:

text.zh: 第3类产品组A“系统、设备和部件”标题后注1和注2的含义是：如“MMIC”为其他用途（例如电信、雷达、汽车）“专门设计”，3A001.b.2不对其实施管制。
text.en: Notes 1 and 2 following the Category 3 heading for product group A. Systems, Equipment, and Components mean that 3A001.b.2 does not control “MMICs” if they are “specially designed” for other applications, e.g., telecommunications, radar, automobiles.

text.zh: b.3. 具有以下任一特性的分立微波晶体管：
text.en: b.3. Discrete microwave transistors that are any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a. 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.3.a. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a.1. 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于400 W（56 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.a.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 400 W (56 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.a.2. 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于205 W（53.12 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.a.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 205 W (53.12 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于115 W（50.61 dBm）；或
text.en: b.3.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 115 W (50.61 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: b.3.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于60 W（47.78 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 60 W (47.78 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.3.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于50 W（47 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 50 W (47 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于15 W（41.76 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 15 W (41.76 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.b.3. 在大于12 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于40 W（46 dBm）；或
text.en: b.3.b.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 40 W (46 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 12 GHz up to and including 16 GHz; or

text.zh: b.3.b.4. 在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于7 W（38.45 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.b.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 7 W (38.45 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.c. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.5 W（27 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.5 W (27 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.d. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于1 W（30 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 1 W (30 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.e. 额定在大于43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；或
text.en: b.3.e. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz; or

text.zh: b.3.f. 3A001.b.3.a至3A001.b.3.e未列明，额定在大于8.5 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的所有频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于5 W（37.0 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.f. Other than those specified by 3A001.b.3.a to 3A001.b.3.e and rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 5 W (37.0 dBm) at all frequencies exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.b.3.a至3A001.b.3.e中的晶体管，如其额定工作频率跨越这些条款所定义的多个频率范围，其管制状态按最低峰值饱和输出功率管制阈值确定。
text.en: The control status of a transistor in 3A001.b.3.a through 3A001.b.3.e, whose rated operating frequency includes frequencies listed in more than one frequency range, as defined by 3A001.b.3.a through 3A001.b.3.e, is determined by the lowest peak saturated power output control threshold.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A001.b.3包括裸芯片、安装于载体上的芯片或封装芯片。某些分立晶体管也可能被称为功率放大器，但其管制状态由3A001.b.3确定。
text.en: 3A001.b.3 includes bare dice, dice mounted on carriers, or dice mounted in packages. Some discrete transistors may also be referred to as power amplifiers, but the status of these discrete transistors is determined by 3A001.b.3.

text.zh: b.4. 具有以下任一特性的微波固态放大器，以及含微波固态放大器的微波组件/模块：
text.en: b.4. Microwave solid state amplifiers and microwave assemblies/modules containing microwave solid state amplifiers, that are any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.4.a. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a.1. 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于500 W（57 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.a.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 500 W (57 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.a.2. 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于270 W（54.3 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.a.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 270 W (54.3 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于200 W（53 dBm）；或
text.en: b.4.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 200 W (53 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: b.4.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于90 W（49.54 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 90 W (49.54 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.4.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于70 W（48.45 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 70 W (48.45 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于50 W（47 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 50 W (47 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.b.3. 在大于12 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于30 W（44.77 dBm）；或
text.en: b.4.b.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 30 W (44.77 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 12 GHz up to and including 16 GHz; or

text.zh: b.4.b.4. 在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 W（43 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.b.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 W (43 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.c. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.5 W（27 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.5 W (27 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.d. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于2 W（33 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.4.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 2 W (33 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.4.e. 额定工作频率超过43.5 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.4.e. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 43.5 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.e.1. 在大于43.5 GHz且不超过75 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.2 W（23 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.4.e.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 0.2 W (23 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz up to and including 75 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.4.e.2. 在大于75 GHz且不超过90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 mW（13 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于5%；或
text.en: b.4.e.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 mW (13 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 75 GHz up to and including 90 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 5%; or

text.zh: b.4.e.3. 在大于90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；或
text.en: b.4.e.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: b.4.f. [保留]
text.en: b.4.f. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 1. “MMIC”放大器见3A001.b.2。
text.en: 1. For “MMIC” amplifiers see 3A001.b.2.

text.zh: 2. “发射/接收模块”和“发射模块”见3A001.b.12。
text.en: 2. For 'transmit/receive modules' and 'transmit modules' see 3A001.b.12.

text.zh: 3. 设计用于扩展信号分析仪、信号发生器、网络分析仪或微波测试接收机的工作范围或频率范围的变频器和谐波混频器，见3A001.b.7。
text.en: 3. For converters and harmonic mixers, designed to extend the operating or frequency range of signal analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers or microwave test receivers, see 3A001.b.7.
Note 1:

text.zh: [保留]
text.en: [Reserved]
Note 2:

text.zh: 如物项额定工作频率跨越3A001.b.4.a至3A001.b.4.e所定义的多个频率范围，其管制状态按最低峰值饱和输出功率管制阈值确定。
text.en: The control status of an item whose rated operating frequency includes frequencies listed in more than one frequency range, as defined by 3A001.b.4.a through 3A001.b.4.e, is determined by the lowest peak saturated power output control threshold.

text.zh: b.5. 采用电子或磁调谐的带通或带阻滤波器，具有5个以上可调谐谐振器，能在小于10 ms内跨越1.5:1频带（f_{max}/f_{min}）调谐，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.5. Electronically or magnetically tunable band-pass or band-stop filters, having more than 5 tunable resonators capable of tuning across a 1.5:1 frequency band (f_{max}/f_{min}) in less than 10 ms and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.5.a. 带通带宽大于中心频率的0.5%；或
text.en: b.5.a. A band-pass bandwidth of more than 0.5% of center frequency; or

text.zh: b.5.b. 带阻带宽小于中心频率的0.5%；
text.en: b.5.b. A band-stop bandwidth of less than 0.5% of center frequency;
b.6. [Reserved]

text.zh: b.7. 具有以下任一特性的变频器和谐波混频器：
text.en: b.7. Converters and harmonic mixers, that are any of the following:

text.zh: b.7.a. 设计用于将“信号分析仪”的频率范围扩展至90 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.a. Designed to extend the frequency range of “signal analyzers” beyond 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.b. 设计用于将信号发生器的工作范围扩展至以下范围：
text.en: b.7.b. Designed to extend the operating range of signal generators as follows:

text.zh: b.7.b.1. 90 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.b.1. Beyond 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.b.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率大于100 mW（20 dBm）；
text.en: b.7.b.2. To an output power greater than 100 mW (20 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.c. 设计用于将网络分析仪的工作范围扩展至以下范围：
text.en: b.7.c. Designed to extend the operating range of network analyzers as follows:

text.zh: b.7.c.1. 110 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.c.1. Beyond 110 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.c.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率大于31.62 mW（15 dBm）；
text.en: b.7.c.2. To an output power greater than 31.62 mW (15 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.c.3. 在大于90 GHz但不超过110 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率大于1 mW（0 dBm）；或
text.en: b.7.c.3. To an output power greater than 1 mW (0 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 90 GHz but not exceeding 110 GHz; or

text.zh: b.7.d. 设计用于将微波测试接收机的频率范围扩展至110 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.d. Designed to extend the frequency range of microwave test receivers beyond 110 GHz;

text.zh: b.8. 含有3A001.b.1管制的“真空电子器件”，且具有以下全部特性的微波功率放大器：
text.en: b.8. Microwave power amplifiers containing “vacuum electronic devices” controlled by 3A001.b.1 and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.8.a. 工作频率高于3 GHz；
text.en: b.8.a. Operating frequencies above 3 GHz;

text.zh: b.8.b. 平均输出功率与质量之比超过80 W/kg；且
text.en: b.8.b. An average output power to mass ratio exceeding 80 W/kg; and

text.zh: b.8.c. 体积小于400 cm^{3}；
text.en: b.8.c. A volume of less than 400 cm^{3};

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.b.8不管制设计或额定在“由ITU分配”用于无线电通信业务而非无线电测定的任何频段工作的设备。
text.en: 3A001.b.8 does not control equipment designed or rated for operation in any frequency band which is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.

text.zh: b.9. 至少由行波“真空电子器件”、“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）及集成电子电源调节器构成，且具有以下全部特性的微波功率模块（MPM）：
text.en: b.9. Microwave Power Modules (MPM) consisting of, at least, a traveling-wave “vacuum electronic device,” a “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) and an integrated electronic power conditioner and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.9.a. 从关闭至完全运行的“开启时间”小于10秒；
text.en: b.9.a. A 'turn-on time' from off to fully operational in less than 10 seconds;

text.zh: b.9.b. 体积小于以瓦计的最大额定功率乘以10 cm^{3}/W；且
text.en: b.9.b. A volume less than the maximum rated power in Watts multiplied by 10 cm^{3}/W; and

text.zh: b.9.c. “瞬时带宽”大于1个倍频程（f_{max} > 2f_{min}），且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.9.c. An “instantaneous bandwidth” greater than 1 octave (f_{max} > 2f_{min}) and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.9.c.1. 对于等于或低于18 GHz的频率，射频输出功率大于100 W；或
text.en: b.9.c.1. For frequencies equal to or less than 18 GHz, an RF output power greater than 100 W; or

text.zh: b.9.c.2. 频率大于18 GHz；
text.en: b.9.c.2. A frequency greater than 18 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A001.b.9:

text.zh: 1. 3A001.b.9.b中的体积计算示例如下：最大额定功率为20 W时，体积为20 W × 10 cm^{3}/W = 200 cm^{3}。
text.en: 1. To calculate the volume in 3A001.b.9.b, the following example is provided: for a maximum rated power of 20 W, the volume would be: 20 W × 10 cm^{3}/W = 200 cm^{3}.

text.zh: 2. 3A001.b.9.a中的“开启时间”指从完全关闭至完全运行的时间，即包括MPM的预热时间。
text.en: 2. The 'turn-on time' in 3A001.b.9.a refers to the time from fully-off to fully operational, i.e., it includes the warm-up time of the MPM.

text.zh: b.10. 规定在10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz范围内任一点，单边带（SSB）相位噪声（dBc/Hz）小于（优于）−（126 + 20log_{10}F − 20log_{10}f）的振荡器或振荡器组件；
text.en: b.10. Oscillators or oscillator assemblies, specified to operate with a single sideband (SSB) phase noise, in dBc/Hz, less (better) than − (126 + 20log_{10}F − 20log_{10}f) anywhere within the range of 10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.b.10而言，F为相对工作频率的偏移量（Hz），f为工作频率（MHz）。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b.10, F is the offset from the operating frequency in Hz and f is the operating frequency in MHz.

text.zh: b.11. “频率切换时间”符合以下任一条件的“频率合成器”“电子组件”：
text.en: b.11. 'Frequency synthesizer' “electronic assemblies” having a “frequency switching time” as specified by any of the following:

text.zh: b.11.a. 小于143 ps；
text.en: b.11.a. Less than 143 ps;

text.zh: b.11.b. 在大于4.8 GHz但不超过31.8 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；
text.en: b.11.b. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 4.8 GHz but not exceeding 31.8 GHz;
b.11.c. [Reserved]

text.zh: b.11.d. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过550 MHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于500 µs；
text.en: b.11.d. Less than 500 µs for any frequency change exceeding 550 MHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.11.e. 在大于37 GHz但不超过75 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；
text.en: b.11.e. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 37 GHz but not exceeding 75 GHz;

text.zh: b.11.f. 在大于75 GHz但不超过90 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过5.0 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；或
text.en: b.11.f. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 5.0 GHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 75 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: b.11.g. 在超过90 GHz的合成频率范围内，切换时间小于1 ms；
text.en: b.11.g. Less than 1 ms within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.b.11而言，“频率合成器”指任何类型的频率源，无论实际采用何种技术，能够从一个或多个输出端提供多个同时或择一输出的频率，这些频率由数量较少的标准（或主）频率控制、派生或校准。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b.11, a 'frequency synthesizer' is any kind of frequency source, regardless of the actual technique used, providing a multiplicity of simultaneous or alternative output frequencies, from one or more outputs, controlled by, derived from or disciplined by a lesser number of standard (or master) frequencies.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 通用“信号分析仪”、信号发生器、网络分析仪及微波测试接收机，分别见3A002.c、3A002.d、3A002.e和3A002.f。
text.en: For general purpose “signal analyzers”, signal generators, network analyzers and microwave test receivers, see 3A002.c, 3A002.d, 3A002.e and 3A002.f, respectively.

text.zh: b.12. 额定工作频率高于2.7 GHz，且具有以下全部特性的“发射/接收模块”、“发射/接收MMIC”、“发射模块”和“发射MMIC”：
text.en: b.12. 'Transmit/receive modules, 'transmit/receive MMICs, 'transmit modules,' and 'transmit MMICs,' rated for operation at frequencies above 2.7 GHz and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.12.a. 任一通道的峰值饱和输出功率P_{sat}（瓦）大于505.62除以最大工作频率（GHz）的平方[P_{sat}>505.62 W*GHz^{2}/f_{GHz}^{2}]；
text.en: b.12.a. A peak saturated power output (in watts), P_{sat}, greater than 505.62 divided by the maximum operating frequency (in GHz) squared [P_{sat}>505.62 W*GHz^{2}/f_{GHz}^{2}] for any channel;

text.zh: b.12.b. 任一通道的“相对带宽”为5%或以上；
text.en: b.12.b. A “fractional bandwidth” of 5% or greater for any channel;

text.zh: b.12.c. 任一平面边长d（cm）等于或小于15除以最低工作频率（GHz）[d ≤ 15cm*GHz*N/f_{GHz}]，其中N为发射或发射/接收通道数；且
text.en: b.12.c. Any planar side with length d (in cm) equal to or less than 15 divided by the lowest operating frequency in GHz [d ≤ 15cm*GHz*N/f_{GHz}] where N is the number of transmit or transmit/receive channels; and

text.zh: b.12.d. 每个通道均有电子可变移相器；
text.en: b.12.d. An electronically variable phase shifter per channel;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A001.b.12:

text.zh: 1. “发射/接收模块”是为信号发射和接收提供双向幅度及相位控制的多功能“电子组件”。
text.en: 1. A 'transmit/receive module' is a multifunction “electronic assembly” that provides bi-directional amplitude and phase control for transmission and reception of signals.

text.zh: 2. “发射模块”是为信号发射提供幅度及相位控制的“电子组件”。
text.en: 2. A 'transmit module' is an “electronic assembly” that provides amplitude and phase control for transmission of signals.

text.zh: 3. “发射/接收MMIC”是为信号发射和接收提供双向幅度及相位控制的多功能“MMIC”。
text.en: 3. A 'transmit/receive MMIC' is a multifunction “MMIC” that provides bi-directional amplitude and phase control for transmission and reception of signals.

text.zh: 4. “发射MMIC”是为信号发射提供幅度及相位控制的“MMIC”。
text.en: 4. A 'transmit MMIC' is a “MMIC” that provides amplitude and phase control for transmission of signals.

text.zh: 5. 对于额定工作范围向下延伸至2.7 GHz或以下的发射/接收模块或发射模块，3A001.b.12.c公式中的最低工作频率（f_{GHz}）应采用2.7 GHz[d≤15cm*GHz*N/2.7 GHz]。
text.en: 5. 2.7 GHz should be used as the lowest operating frequency (f_{GHz}) in the formula in 3A001.b.12.c for transmit/receive or transmit modules that have a rated operation range extending downward to 2.7 GHz and below [d≤15cm*GHz*N/2.7 GHz].

text.zh: 6. 3A001.b.12适用于带或不带散热器的“发射/接收模块”或“发射模块”。3A001.b.12.c中d的数值不包括这些模块中发挥散热器功能的任何部分。
text.en: 6. 3A001.b.12 applies to 'transmit/receive modules' or 'transmit modules' with or without a heat sink. The value of d in 3A001.b.12.c does not include any portion of the 'transmit/receive module' or 'transmit module' that functions as a heat sink.

text.zh: 7. “发射/接收模块”或“发射模块”、“发射/接收MMIC”或“发射MMIC”可以具有或不具有N个集成辐射天线单元，其中N为发射或发射/接收通道数。
text.en: 7. 'Transmit/receive modules' or 'transmit modules,' 'transmit/receive MMICs' or 'transmit MMICs' may or may not have N integrated radiating antenna elements where N is the number of transmit or transmit/receive channels.

text.zh: c. 如下声波器件及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: c. Acoustic wave devices as follows and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下任一特性的表面声波及掠表面（浅体）声波器件：
text.en: c.1. Surface acoustic wave and surface skimming (shallow bulk) acoustic wave devices, having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 载波频率超过6 GHz；
text.en: c.1.a. A carrier frequency exceeding 6 GHz;

text.zh: c.1.b. 载波频率超过1 GHz但不超过6 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: c.1.b. A carrier frequency exceeding 1 GHz, but not exceeding 6 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.b.1. “频率旁瓣抑制”超过65 dB；
text.en: c.1.b.1. A 'frequency side-lobe rejection' exceeding 65 dB;

text.zh: c.1.b.2. 最大延迟时间与带宽的乘积大于100（时间以µs计，带宽以MHz计）；
text.en: c.1.b.2. A product of the maximum delay time and the bandwidth (time in µs and bandwidth in MHz) of more than 100;

text.zh: c.1.b.3. 带宽大于250 MHz；或
text.en: c.1.b.3. A bandwidth greater than 250 MHz; or

text.zh: c.1.b.4. 色散延迟大于10 µs；或
text.en: c.1.b.4. A dispersive delay of more than 10 µs; or

text.zh: c.1.c. 载波频率为1 GHz或以下，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: c.1.c. A carrier frequency of 1 GHz or less and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.c.1. 最大延迟时间与带宽的乘积大于100（时间以µs计，带宽以MHz计）；
text.en: c.1.c.1. A product of the maximum delay time and the bandwidth (time in µs and bandwidth in MHz) of more than 100;

text.zh: c.1.c.2. 色散延迟大于10 µs；或
text.en: c.1.c.2. A dispersive delay of more than 10 µs; or

text.zh: c.1.c.3. “频率旁瓣抑制”超过65 dB，且带宽大于100 MHz；
text.en: c.1.c.3. A 'frequency side-lobe rejection' exceeding 65 dB and a bandwidth greater than 100 MHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.c.1而言，“频率旁瓣抑制”指数据表规定的最大抑制值。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.c.1, 'frequency side-lobe rejection' is the maximum rejection value specified in data sheet.

text.zh: c.2. 能直接处理频率超过6 GHz信号的体声波器件；
text.en: c.2. Bulk (volume) acoustic wave devices that permit the direct processing of signals at frequencies exceeding 6 GHz;

text.zh: c.3. 利用声波（体波或表面波）与光波相互作用，能够直接处理信号或图像，包括频谱分析、相关或卷积的声光“信号处理”器件；
text.en: c.3. Acoustic-optic “signal processing” devices employing interaction between acoustic waves (bulk wave or surface wave) and light waves that permit the direct processing of signals or images, including spectral analysis, correlation or convolution;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.c不管制仅具有单一带通、低通、高通或陷波滤波功能，或谐振功能的声波器件。
text.en: 3A001.c does not control acoustic wave devices that are limited to a single band pass, low pass, high pass or notch filtering, or resonating function.

text.zh: d. 含有由“超导”材料制造的“部件”，为在低于至少一种“超导”组分的“临界温度”下工作而“专门设计”，且具有以下任一特性的电子器件和电路：
text.en: d. Electronic devices and circuits containing “components,” manufactured from “superconductive” materials, “specially designed” for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of the “superconductive” constituents and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 采用“超导”门对数字电路进行电流切换，每个门的延迟时间（秒）与功耗（瓦）的乘积小于10^{−14} J；或
text.en: d.1. Current switching for digital circuits using “superconductive” gates with a product of delay time per gate (in seconds) and power dissipation per gate (in watts) of less than 10^{−14} J; or

text.zh: d.2. 采用Q值超过10,000的谐振电路，在所有频率下进行频率选择；
text.en: d.2. Frequency selection at all frequencies using resonant circuits with Q-values exceeding 10,000;

text.zh: e. 如下高能器件：
text.en: e. High energy devices as follows:

text.zh: e.1. 如下“电池单体”：
text.en: e.1. 'Cells' as follows:

text.zh: e.1.a. 在20 °C时具有以下任一特性的“原电池单体”：
text.en: e.1.a 'Primary cells' having any of the following at 20 °C:

text.zh: e.1.a.1. “能量密度”超过550 Wh/kg，且“连续功率密度”超过50 W/kg；或
text.en: e.1.a.1. 'Energy density' exceeding 550 Wh/kg and a 'continuous power density' exceeding 50 W/kg; or

text.zh: e.1.a.2. “能量密度”超过50 Wh/kg，且“连续功率密度”超过350 W/kg；
text.en: e.1.a.2. 'Energy density' exceeding 50 Wh/kg and a 'continuous power density' exceeding 350 W/kg;

text.zh: e.1.b. 在20 °C时“能量密度”超过350 Wh/kg的“二次电池单体”；
text.en: e.1.b. 'Secondary cells' having an 'energy density' exceeding 350 Wh/kg at 20 °C;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3A001.e.1而言，“能量密度”（Wh/kg）按标称电压乘以标称容量（Ah），再除以质量（kg）计算。如未标明标称容量，则以标称电压的平方乘以放电持续时间（小时），再除以放电负载（欧姆）及质量（kg）计算。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1, 'energy density' (Wh/kg) is calculated from the nominal voltage multiplied by the nominal capacity in ampere-hours (Ah) divided by the mass in kilograms. If the nominal capacity is not stated, energy density is calculated from the nominal voltage squared then multiplied by the discharge duration in hours divided by the discharge load in Ohms and the mass in kilograms.

text.zh: 2. 就3A001.e.1而言，“电池单体”定义为具有正负电极和电解质、提供电能的电化学装置，是构成电池的基本单元。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1, a 'cell' is defined as an electrochemical device, which has positive and negative electrodes, an electrolyte, and is a source of electrical energy. It is the basic building block of a battery.

text.zh: 3. 就3A001.e.1.a而言，“原电池单体”是未设计为可由任何其他能源充电的“电池单体”。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1.a, a 'primary cell' is a 'cell' that is not designed to be charged by any other source.

text.zh: 4. 就3A001.e.1.b而言，“二次电池单体”是设计为可由外部电源充电的“电池单体”。
text.en: 4. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1.b, a 'secondary cell' is a 'cell' that is designed to be charged by an external electrical source.

text.zh: 5. 就3A001.e.1.a而言，“连续功率密度”（W/kg）按标称电压乘以规定的最大连续放电电流（A），再除以质量（kg）计算。“连续功率密度”也称比功率。
text.en: 5. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1.a, 'continuous power density' (W/kg) is calculated from the nominal voltage multiplied by the specified maximum continuous discharge current in ampere (A) divided by the mass in kilograms. 'Continuous power density' is also referred to as specific power.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.e不管制电池，包括单电芯电池。
text.en: 3A001.e does not control batteries, including single-cell batteries.

text.zh: e.2. 如下高储能电容器：
text.en: e.2. High energy storage capacitors as follows:

text.zh: e.2.a. 重复频率小于10 Hz（单次放电电容器），且具有以下全部特性的电容器：
text.en: e.2.a. Capacitors with a repetition rate of less than 10 Hz (single shot capacitors) and having all of the following:

text.zh: e.2.a.1. 额定电压等于或大于5 kV；
text.en: e.2.a.1. A voltage rating equal to or more than 5 kV;

text.zh: e.2.a.2. 能量密度等于或大于250 J/kg；且
text.en: e.2.a.2. An energy density equal to or more than 250 J/kg; and

text.zh: e.2.a.3. 总能量等于或大于25 kJ；
text.en: e.2.a.3. A total energy equal to or more than 25 kJ;

text.zh: e.2.b. 重复频率为10 Hz或以上（额定重复放电电容器），且具有以下全部特性的电容器：
text.en: e.2.b. Capacitors with a repetition rate of 10 Hz or more (repetition rated capacitors) and having all of the following:

text.zh: e.2.b.1. 额定电压等于或大于5 kV；
text.en: e.2.b.1. A voltage rating equal to or more than 5 kV;

text.zh: e.2.b.2. 能量密度等于或大于50 J/kg；
text.en: e.2.b.2. An energy density equal to or more than 50 J/kg;

text.zh: e.2.b.3. 总能量等于或大于100 J；且
text.en: e.2.b.3. A total energy equal to or more than 100 J; and

text.zh: e.2.b.4. 充放电循环寿命等于或大于10,000次；
text.en: e.2.b.4. A charge/discharge cycle life equal to or more than 10,000;

text.zh: e.3. 为在不到一秒内完全充电或放电而“专门设计”，且具有以下全部特性的“超导”电磁体和螺线管：
text.en: e.3. “Superconductive” electromagnets and solenoids, “specially designed” to be fully charged or discharged in less than one second and having all of the following:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.e.3不管制为磁共振成像（MRI）医疗设备“专门设计”的“超导”电磁体或螺线管。
text.en: 3A001.e.3 does not control “superconductive” electromagnets or solenoids “specially designed” for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) medical equipment.

text.zh: e.3.a. 放电第一秒内释放的能量超过10 kJ；
text.en: e.3.a. Energy delivered during the discharge exceeding 10 kJ in the first second;

text.zh: e.3.b. 载流绕组内径大于250 mm；且
text.en: e.3.b. Inner diameter of the current carrying windings of more than 250 mm; and

text.zh: e.3.c. 额定磁感应强度大于8 T，或绕组中的“总电流密度”大于300 A/mm^{2}；
text.en: e.3.c. Rated for a magnetic induction of more than 8 T or “overall current density” in the winding of more than 300 A/mm^{2};

text.zh: e.4. 具有“空间合格”资格的太阳能电池单体、电池-互连-盖片玻璃（CIC）组件、太阳能电池板及太阳能电池阵列，在301 K（28 °C）工作温度、辐照度为1,367 W/m^{2}的模拟“AM0”光照下，最低平均效率超过20%；
text.en: e.4. Solar cells, cell-interconnect-coverglass (CIC) assemblies, solar panels, and solar arrays, which are “space-qualified,” having a minimum average efficiency exceeding 20% at an operating temperature of 301 K (28 °C) under simulated 'AM0' illumination with an irradiance of 1,367 Watts per square meter (W/m^{2});

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.e.4而言，“AM0”或“零大气质量”指日地距离为一个天文单位（AU）时，地球外层大气处太阳光的光谱辐照度。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.e.4, 'AM0', or 'Air Mass Zero', refers to the spectral irradiance of sun light in the earth's outer atmosphere when the distance between the earth and sun is one astronomical unit (AU).

text.zh: f. “精度”等于或小于（优于）1.0角秒的旋转输入式绝对位置编码器，以及为其“专门设计”的编码环、盘或标尺；
text.en: f. Rotary input type absolute position encoders having an “accuracy” equal to or less (better) than 1.0 second of arc and “specially designed” encoder rings, discs or scales therefor;

text.zh: g. 采用电、光或电子辐射控制开关方式，且具有以下任一特性的固态脉冲功率开关晶闸管器件和“晶闸管模块”：
text.en: g. Solid-state pulsed power switching thyristor devices and 'thyristor modules', using either electrically, optically, or electron radiation controlled switch methods and having any of the following:

text.zh: g.1. 最大导通电流上升率（di/dt）大于30,000 A/µs，且关断态电压大于1,100 V；或
text.en: g.1. A maximum turn-on current rate of rise (di/dt) greater than 30,000 A/µs and off-state voltage greater than 1,100 V; or

text.zh: g.2. 最大导通电流上升率（di/dt）大于2,000 A/µs，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: g.2. A maximum turn-on current rate of rise (di/dt) greater than 2,000 A/µs and having all of the following:

text.zh: g.2.a. 关断态峰值电压等于或大于3,000 V；且
text.en: g.2.a. An off-state peak voltage equal to or greater than 3,000 V; and

text.zh: g.2.b. 峰值（浪涌）电流等于或大于3,000 A；
text.en: g.2.b. A peak (surge) current equal to or greater than 3,000 A;
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.g包括：
text.en: 3A001.g. includes:

text.zh: —可控硅整流器（SCR）
text.en: —Silicon Controlled Rectifiers (SCRs)

text.zh: 3A001.g不管制集成于为民用铁路或“民用航空器”用途设计的设备中的晶闸管器件和“晶闸管模块”。
text.en: 3A001.g does not control thyristor devices and 'thyristor modules' incorporated into equipment designed for civil railway or “civil aircraft” applications.

text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.g而言，“晶闸管模块”含一个或多个晶闸管器件。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.g, a 'thyristor module' contains one or more thyristor devices.

text.zh: h. 具有以下全部特性的固态功率半导体开关、二极管或“模块”：
text.en: h. Solid-state power semiconductor switches, diodes, or 'modules', having all of the following:

text.zh: h.1. 额定最高工作结温大于488 K（215 °C）；
text.en: h.1. Rated for a maximum operating junction temperature greater than 488 K (215 °C);

text.zh: h.2. 重复峰值关断态电压（阻断电压）超过300 V；且
text.en: h.2. Repetitive peak off-state voltage (blocking voltage) exceeding 300 V; and

text.zh: h.3. 连续电流大于1 A。
text.en: h.3. Continuous current greater than 1 A.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.h而言，“模块”含一个或多个固态功率半导体开关或二极管。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.h, 'modules' contain one or more solid-state power semiconductor switches or diodes.
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.h中的重复峰值关断态电压包括漏源电压、集电极-发射极电压、重复峰值反向电压和重复峰值关断态阻断电压。
text.en: Repetitive peak off-state voltage in 3A001.h includes drain to source voltage, collector to emitter voltage, repetitive peak reverse voltage and peak repetitive off-state blocking voltage.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A001.h包括：
text.en: 3A001.h includes:

text.en: —Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistors (MOSFETs)

text.en: —Double Diffused Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistor (DMOSFET)

text.en: —Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT)

text.en: —Bipolar Junction Transistors (BJTs)

text.zh: 3A001.h不适用于集成于为民用汽车、民用铁路或“民用航空器”用途设计的设备中的开关、二极管或“模块”。
text.en: 3A001.h does not apply to switches, diodes, or 'modules', incorporated into equipment designed for civil automobile, civil railway, or “civil aircraft” applications.

text.zh: i. 为模拟信号设计且具有以下任一特性的强度、幅度或相位电光调制器：
text.en: i. Intensity, amplitude, or phase electro-optic modulators, designed for analog signals and having any of the following:

text.zh: i.1. 最大工作频率大于10 GHz但小于20 GHz，光插入损耗等于或小于3 dB，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: i.1. A maximum operating frequency of more than 10 GHz but less than 20 GHz, an optical insertion loss equal to or less than 3 dB and having any of the following:

text.zh: i.1.a. 在1 GHz或以下频率测量时，“半波电压”（“Vπ”）小于2.7 V；或
text.en: i.1.a. A 'half-wave voltage' ('Vπ') less than 2.7 V when measured at a frequency of 1 GHz or below; or

text.zh: i.1.b. 在大于1 GHz的频率测量时，“Vπ”小于4 V；或
text.en: i.1.b. A 'Vπ' of less than 4 V when measured at a frequency of more than 1 GHz; or

text.zh: i.2. 最大工作频率等于或大于20 GHz，光插入损耗等于或小于3 dB，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: i.2. A maximum operating frequency equal to or greater than 20 GHz, an optical insertion loss equal to or less than 3 dB and having any of the following:

text.zh: i.2.a. 在1 GHz或以下频率测量时，“Vπ”小于3.3 V；或
text.en: i.2.a. A 'Vπ' less than 3.3 V when measured at a frequency of 1 GHz or below; or

text.zh: i.2.b. 在大于1 GHz的频率测量时，“Vπ”小于5 V。
text.en: i.2.b. A 'Vπ' less than 5 V when measured at a frequency of more than 1 GHz.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.i包括具有光输入及输出连接器（例如光纤尾纤）的电光调制器。
text.en: 3A001.i includes electro-optic modulators having optical input and output connectors (e.g., fiber-optic pigtails).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.i而言，“半波电压”（“Vπ”）指使在光调制器中传播的光产生180度相位变化所需施加的电压。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.i, a 'half-wave voltage' ('Vπ') is the applied voltage necessary to make a phase change of 180 degrees in the wavelength of light propagating through the optical modulator.

text.zh: j.至y. [保留]
text.en: j. through y. [Reserved]

text.zh: z. 3A001所述、达到或超过3A090性能参数的任何商品，如下：
text.en: z. Any commodity described in 3A001 that meets or exceeds the performance parameters in 3A090, as follows:

text.zh: z.1.a. 3A001.b.2所述“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器及3A001.b.3中的分立微波晶体管，同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数，但为民用电信用途出口或再出口的3A001.b.2和b.3物项除外；
text.en: z.1.a “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers described in 3A001.b.2 and discrete microwave transistors in 3A001.b.3 that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a, except those 3A001.b.2 and b.3 items being exported or reexported for use in civil telecommunications applications;

text.zh: z.1.b. 3A001.b.2所述“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器及3A001.b.3中的分立微波晶体管，同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数，但为民用电信用途出口或再出口的3A001.b.2和b.3物项除外；
text.en: z.1.b “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers described in 3A001.b.2 and discrete microwave transistors in 3A001.b.3 that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b, except those 3A001.b.2 and b.3 items being exported or reexported for use in civil telecommunications applications;

text.zh: z.2.a. 3A001.a.1.a所述、可用于“导弹”且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数的商品；以及3A001.a.5.a所述、为军事用途“设计或改装”、气密封装、额定工作温度范围从低于−54 °C至高于+125 °C，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.2.a Commodities that are described in 3A001.a.1.a when usable in “missiles” that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a; and to 3A001.a.5.a when “designed or modified” for military use, hermetically sealed and rated for operation in the temperature range from below −54 °C to above +125 °C and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a;

text.zh: z.2.b. 3A001.a.1.a所述、可用于“导弹”且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数的商品；以及3A001.a.5.a所述、为军事用途“设计或改装”、气密封装、额定工作温度范围从低于−54 °C至高于+125 °C，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.2.b Commodities that are described in 3A001.a.1.a when usable in “missiles” that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b; and to 3A001.a.5.a when “designed or modified” for military use, hermetically sealed and rated for operation in the temperature range from below −54 °C to above +125 °C and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b;

text.zh: z.3.a. 3A001.e.2所述脉冲放电电容器及3A001.e.3中的超导螺线管电磁体，分别达到或超过3A201.a和3A201.b技术参数，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数；
text.en: z.3.a. Pulse discharge capacitors described in 3A001.e.2 and superconducting solenoidal electromagnets in 3A001.e.3 that meet or exceed the technical parameters in 3A201.a and 3A201.b, respectively and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a;

text.zh: z.3.b. 3A001.e.2所述脉冲放电电容器及3A001.e.3中的超导螺线管电磁体，分别达到或超过3A201.a和3A201.b技术参数，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数；
text.en: z.3.b Pulse discharge capacitors described in 3A001.e.2 and superconducting solenoidal electromagnets in 3A001.e.3 that meet or exceed the technical parameters in 3A201.a and 3A201.b, respectively and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b;

text.zh: z.4.a. 本ECCN所列达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数的所有其他商品；或
text.en: z.4.a. All other commodities specified in this ECCN that meet or exceed the performance parameters of ECCN 3A090.a; or

text.zh: z.4.b. 本ECCN所列达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数的所有其他商品。
text.en: z.4.b All other commodities specified in this ECCN that meet or exceed the performance parameters of ECCN 3A090.b.
