text.zh: 相关管制：某些“受ITAR管辖”的“空间合格”原子频率标准见USML第XV(e)(9)类（见22 CFR Parts 120至130）。另见3A101、3A992和9A515.x。
text.en: Related Controls: See Category XV(e)(9) of the USML for certain “space-qualified” atomic frequency standards “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). See also 3A101, 3A992 and 9A515.x.

text.zh: 相关定义：恒定百分比带宽滤波器也称倍频程或分数倍频程滤波器。
text.en: Related Definitions: Constant percentage bandwidth filters are also known as octave or fractional octave filters.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 如下记录设备和示波器：
text.en: a. Recording equipment and oscilloscopes, as follows:
a.1. to a.5. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 波形数字化仪和瞬态记录仪见3A002.h。
text.en: For waveform digitizers and transient recorders, see 3A002.h.

text.zh: a.6. 具有以下全部特性的数字数据记录仪：
text.en: a.6. Digital data recorders having all of the following:

text.zh: a.6.a. 向磁盘或固态驱动器存储器持续写入的“连续吞吐量”大于6.4 Gbit/s；且
text.en: a.6.a. A sustained 'continuous throughput' of more than 6.4 Gbit/s to disk or solid-state drive memory; and

text.zh: a.6.b. 在记录射频信号数据的同时对其进行“信号处理”；
text.en: a.6.b. “Signal processing” of the radio frequency signal data while it is being recorded;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A002.a.6:

text.zh: 1. 对采用并行总线架构的记录仪，“连续吞吐量”速率为最高字速率乘以每字位数。
text.en: 1. For recorders with a parallel bus architecture, the 'continuous throughput' rate is the highest word rate multiplied by the number of bits in a word.

text.zh: 2. “连续吞吐量”指仪器在维持输入数字数据率或数字化仪转换速率的同时，不丢失任何信息地将数据记录至磁盘或固态驱动器存储器的最快数据率。
text.en: 2. 'Continuous throughput' is the fastest data rate the instrument can record to disk or solid-state drive memory without the loss of any information while sustaining the input digital data rate or digitizer conversion rate.

text.zh: a.7. 对每通道任一60 GHz或以上输入3 dB带宽，在产生最低噪声值的垂直刻度设置下，垂直均方根（rms）噪声电压小于满量程2%的实时示波器；
text.en: a.7. Real-time oscilloscopes having a vertical root-mean-square (rms) noise voltage of less than 2% of full-scale at the vertical scale setting that provides the lowest noise value for any input 3dB bandwidth of 60 GHz or greater per channel;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A002.a.7不适用于等效时间采样示波器。
text.en: 3A002.a.7 does not apply to equivalent-time sampling oscilloscopes.

text.zh: b. [保留]
text.en: b. [Reserved]

text.zh: c. 如下“信号分析仪”：
text.en: c. “Signal analyzers” as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内任一点，3 dB分辨率带宽（RBW）超过40 MHz的“信号分析仪”；
text.en: c.1. “Signal analyzers” having a 3 dB resolution bandwidth (RBW) exceeding 40 MHz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: c.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，显示平均噪声电平（DANL）小于（优于）−150 dBm/Hz的“信号分析仪”；
text.en: c.2. “Signal analyzers” having a Displayed Average Noise Level (DANL) less (better) than −150 dBm/Hz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: c.3. 频率超过90 GHz的“信号分析仪”；
text.en: c.3. “Signal analyzers” having a frequency exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: c.4. 具有以下全部特性的“信号分析仪”：
text.en: c.4. “Signal analyzers” having all of the following:

text.zh: c.4.a. “实时带宽”超过170 MHz；且
text.en: c.4.a. 'Real-time bandwidth' exceeding 170 MHz; and

text.zh: c.4.b. 具有以下任一特性：
text.en: c.4.b. Having any of the following:

text.zh: c.4.b.1. 对持续时间为15 µs或以下的信号，发现概率为100%，且因间隙或加窗效应造成的幅度损失小于相对于完整幅度的3 dB；或
text.en: c.4.b.1. 100% probability of discovery, with less than a 3 dB reduction from full amplitude due to gaps or windowing effects, of signals having a duration of 15 µs or less; or

text.zh: c.4.b.2. 具有“频率模板触发”功能，对持续时间为15 µs或以下的信号，触发（捕获）概率为100%；
text.en: c.4.b.2. A 'frequency mask trigger' function, with 100% probability of trigger (capture) for signals having a duration of 15 µs or less;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3A002.c.4.a而言，“实时带宽”指分析仪在输出或显示转换后数据的同时，采用处理每个输入时间点的傅里叶或其他离散时间变换，将时域数据连续完整地转换为频域结果，且因间隙或加窗效应造成的测量幅度降低不超过相对实际信号幅度3 dB时的最宽频率范围。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.a, 'real-time bandwidth' is the widest frequency range for which the analyzer can continuously transform time-domain data entirely into frequency-domain results, using a Fourier or other discrete time transform that processes every incoming time point, without a reduction of measured amplitude of more than 3 dB below the actual signal amplitude caused by gaps or windowing effects, while outputting or displaying the transformed data.

text.zh: 2. 就3A002.c.4.b.1而言，发现概率也称截获概率或捕获概率。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.b.1., probability of discovery is also referred to as probability of intercept or probability of capture.

text.zh: 3. 就3A002.c.4.b.1而言，100%发现概率所对应的持续时间，等于达到规定电平测量不确定度所需的最短信号持续时间。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.b.1, the duration for 100% probability of discovery is equivalent to the minimum signal duration necessary for the specified level measurement uncertainty.

text.zh: 4. 就3A002.c.4.b.2而言，“频率模板触发”是一种触发功能可选择采集带宽的某个频率子范围作为触发范围，而忽略同一采集带宽内可能存在的其他信号的机制。“频率模板触发”可包含多组独立限值。
text.en: 4. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.b.2, a 'frequency mask trigger' is a mechanism where the trigger function is able to select a frequency range to be triggered on as a subset of the acquisition bandwidth while ignoring other signals that may also be present within the same acquisition bandwidth. A 'frequency mask trigger' may contain more than one independent set of limits.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A002.c.4不适用于仅使用恒定百分比带宽滤波器（亦称倍频程或分数倍频程滤波器）的“信号分析仪”。
text.en: 3A002.c.4 does not apply to those “signal analyzers” using only constant percentage bandwidth filters (also known as octave or fractional octave filters).
c.5. [Reserved]

text.zh: d. 具有以下任一特性的信号发生器：
text.en: d. Signal generators having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 规定能在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内任一点，生成具有以下全部特性的脉冲调制信号：
text.en: d.1. Specified to generate pulse-modulated signals having all of the following, anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz:

text.zh: d.1.a. “脉冲持续时间”小于25 ns；且
text.en: d.1.a. 'Pulse duration' of less than 25 ns; and

text.zh: d.1.b. 通断比等于或超过65 dB；
text.en: d.1.b. On/off ratio equal to or exceeding 65 dB;

text.zh: d.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率超过100 mW（20 dBm）；
text.en: d.2. An output power exceeding 100 mW (20 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: d.3. “频率切换时间”符合以下任一条件：
text.en: d.3. A “frequency switching time” as specified by any of the following:

text.zh: d.3.a. [保留]
text.en: d.3.a. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.3.b. 在大于4.8 GHz但不超过31.8 GHz的频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；
text.en: d.3.b. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 4.8 GHz but not exceeding 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: d.3.c. [保留]
text.en: d.3.c. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.3.d. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内，对超过550 MHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于500 µs；
text.en: d.3.d. Less than 500 µs for any frequency change exceeding 550 MHz within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: d.3.e. 在大于37 GHz但不超过75 GHz的频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；或
text.en: d.3.e. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 37 GHz but not exceeding 75 GHz; or

text.zh: d.3.f. [保留]
text.en: d.3.f. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.3.g. 在大于75 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内，对超过5.0 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs。
text.en: d.3.g. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 5.0 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 75 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz.

text.zh: d.4. 单边带（SSB）相位噪声（dBc/Hz）规定符合以下任一条件：
text.en: d.4. A single sideband (SSB) phase noise, in dBc/Hz, specified as being any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.a. 在大于3.2 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，且在10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz范围内任一点，小于（优于）−（126 + 20 log_{10} F−20log_{10}f）；或
text.en: d.4.a. Less (better) than −(126 + 20 log_{10} F−20log_{10}f) for anywhere within the range of 10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 3.2 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: d.4.b. 在大于3.2 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，且在10 kHz < F ≤ 100 kHz范围内任一点，小于（优于）−（206−20log_{10}f）；
text.en: d.4.b. Less (better) than −(206−20log_{10}f) for anywhere within the range of 10 kHz < F ≤ 100 kHz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 3.2 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A002.d.4而言，F为相对工作频率的偏移量（Hz），f为工作频率（MHz）。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.d.4, F is the offset from the operating frequency in Hz and f is the operating frequency in MHz.

text.zh: d.5. 数字基带信号的“射频调制带宽”符合以下任一条件：
text.en: d.5. An 'RF modulation bandwidth' of digital baseband signals as specified by any of the following:

text.zh: d.5.a. 在大于4.8 GHz但不超过31.8 GHz的频率范围内，超过2.2 GHz；
text.en: d.5.a. Exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 4.8 GHz but not exceeding 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: d.5.b. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内，超过550 MHz；
text.en: d.5.b. Exceeding 550 MHz within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: d.5.c. 在大于37 GHz但不超过75 GHz的频率范围内，超过2.2 GHz；
text.en: d.5.c. Exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 37 GHz but not exceeding 75 GHz;

text.zh: d.5.d. 在大于75 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内，超过5.0 GHz；或
text.en: d.5.d. Exceeding 5.0 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 75 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A002.d.5而言，“射频调制带宽”指数字编码基带信号调制到射频信号上所占用的射频（RF）带宽，也称信息带宽或矢量调制带宽。I/Q数字调制是产生矢量调制射频输出信号的技术方法，该输出信号通常以“射频调制带宽”表征。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.d.5, 'RF modulation bandwidth' is the Radio Frequency (RF) bandwidth occupied by a digitally encoded baseband signal modulated onto an RF signal. It is also referred to as information bandwidth or vector modulation bandwidth. I/Q digital modulation is the technical method for producing a vector-modulated RF output signal, and that output signal is typically specified as having an 'RF modulation bandwidth'.

text.zh: d.6. 最大频率超过90 GHz；
text.en: d.6. A maximum frequency exceeding 90 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: 就3A002.d而言，信号发生器包括任意波形发生器和函数发生器。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.d, signal generators include arbitrary waveform and function generators.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A002.d不管制输出频率通过两个或以上晶体振荡器频率相加或相减，或相加或相减后再对结果倍频而产生的设备。
text.en: 3A002.d does not control equipment in which the output frequency is either produced by the addition or subtraction of two or more crystal oscillator frequencies, or by an addition or subtraction followed by a multiplication of the result.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3A002.d而言，任意波形发生器或函数发生器的最大频率，按采样率（样本/秒）除以2.5计算。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A002.d, the maximum frequency of an arbitrary waveform or function generator is calculated by dividing the sample rate, in samples/second, by a factor of 2.5.

text.zh: 2. 就3A002.d.1.a而言，“脉冲持续时间”定义为从前沿达到脉冲幅度50%的点，到后沿达到脉冲幅度50%的点之间的时间间隔。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A002.d.1.a, 'pulse duration' is defined as the time interval from the point on the leading edge that is 50% of the pulse amplitude to the point on the trailing edge that is 50% of the pulse amplitude.

text.zh: e. 具有以下任一特性的网络分析仪：
text.en: e. Network analyzers having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的工作频率范围内任一点，输出功率超过31.62 mW（15 dBm）；
text.en: e.1. An output power exceeding 31.62 mW (15 dBm) anywhere within the operating frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: e.2. 在大于90 GHz但不超过110 GHz的工作频率范围内任一点，输出功率超过1 mW（0 dBm）；
text.en: e.2. An output power exceeding 1 mW (0 dBm) anywhere within the operating frequency range exceeding 90 GHz but not exceeding 110 GHz;

text.zh: e.3. 在大于50 GHz但不超过110 GHz的频率下具有“非线性矢量测量功能”；或
text.en: e.3. 'Nonlinear vector measurement functionality' at frequencies exceeding 50 GHz but not exceeding 110 GHz; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A002.e.3而言，“非线性矢量测量功能”指仪器分析被驱动至大信号区或非线性失真区的器件测试结果的能力。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.e.3, 'nonlinear vector measurement functionality' is an instrument's ability to analyze the test results of devices driven into the large-signal domain or the non-linear distortion range.

text.zh: e.4. 最大工作频率超过110 GHz；
text.en: e.4. A maximum operating frequency exceeding 110 GHz;

text.zh: f. 具有以下全部特性的微波测试接收机：
text.en: f. Microwave test receivers having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1. 最大工作频率超过110 GHz；且
text.en: f.1. Maximum operating frequency exceeding 110 GHz; and

text.zh: f.2. 能同时测量幅度和相位；
text.en: f.2. Being capable of measuring amplitude and phase simultaneously;

text.zh: g. 具有以下任一特性的原子频率标准：
text.en: g. Atomic frequency standards being any of the following:

text.zh: g.1. 具有“空间合格”资格；
text.en: g.1. “Space-qualified”;

text.zh: g.2. 非铷型，且长期稳定性小于（优于）1 × 10^{−11}/月；或
text.en: g.2. Non-rubidium and having a long-term stability less (better) than 1 × 10^{−11}/month; or

text.zh: g.3. 非“空间合格”，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: g.3. Non-“space-qualified” and having all of the following:

text.zh: g.3.a. 为铷频标；
text.en: g.3.a. Being a rubidium standard;

text.zh: g.3.b. 长期稳定性小于（优于）1 × 10^{−11}/月；且
text.en: g.3.b. Long-term stability less (better) than 1 × 10^{−11}/month; and

text.zh: g.3.c. 总功耗小于1瓦。
text.en: g.3.c. Total power consumption of less than 1 Watt.

text.zh: h. 规定执行以下全部功能的“电子组件”、模块或设备：
text.en: h. “Electronic assemblies,” modules or equipment, specified to perform all of the following:

text.zh: h.1. 满足以下任一条件的模数转换：
text.en: h.1. Analog-to-digital conversions meeting any of the following:

text.zh: h.1.a. 分辨率为8 bit或以上但小于10 bit，“采样率”大于1.3吉样本/秒（GSPS）；
text.en: h.1.a. A resolution of 8 bit or more, but less than 10 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.3 Giga Samples Per Second (GSPS);

text.zh: h.1.b. 分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit，“采样率”大于1.0 GSPS；
text.en: h.1.b. A resolution of 10 bit or more, but less than 12 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.0 GSPS;

text.zh: h.1.c. 分辨率为12 bit或以上但小于14 bit，“采样率”大于1.0 GSPS；
text.en: h.1.c. A resolution of 12 bit or more, but less than 14 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.0 GSPS;

text.zh: h.1.d. 分辨率为14 bit或以上但小于16 bit，“采样率”大于400兆样本/秒（MSPS）；或
text.en: h.1.d. A resolution of 14 bit or more but less than 16 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 400 Mega Samples Per Second (MSPS); or

text.zh: h.1.e. 分辨率为16 bit或以上，“采样率”大于180 MSPS；且
text.en: h.1.e. A resolution of 16 bit or more with a “sample rate” greater than 180 MSPS; and

text.zh: h.2. 以下任一功能：
text.en: h.2. Any of the following:

text.zh: h.2.a. 输出数字化数据；
text.en: h.2.a. Output of digitized data;

text.zh: h.2.b. 存储数字化数据；或
text.en: h.2.b. Storage of digitized data; or

text.zh: h.2.c. 处理数字化数据；
text.en: h.2.c. Processing of digitized data;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 数字数据记录仪、示波器、“信号分析仪”、信号发生器、网络分析仪及微波测试接收机，分别由3A002.a.6、3A002.a.7、3A002.c、3A002.d、3A002.e和3A002.f列明。
text.en: Digital data recorders, oscilloscopes, “signal analyzers,” signal generators, network analyzers and microwave test receivers, are specified by 3A002.a.6, 3A002.a.7, 3A002.c, 3A002.d, 3A002.e and 3A002.f, respectively.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3A002.h而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.h:

text.zh: 1. n bit分辨率对应2^{n}个量化等级。
text.en: 1. A resolution of n bit corresponds to a quantization of 2^{n} levels.

text.zh: 2. ADC的分辨率是其数字输出中表示被测模拟输入字的位数。有效位数（ENOB）不用于确定ADC分辨率。
text.en: 2. The resolution of the ADC is the number of bits of the digital output of the ADC that represents the measured analog input word. Effective Number of Bits (ENOB) is not used to determine the resolution of the ADC.

text.zh: 3. 对于非交织多通道“电子组件”、模块或设备，“采样率”不累加，以任一单通道的最大速率为“采样率”。
text.en: 3. For non-interleaved multiple-channel “electronic assemblies”, modules, or equipment, the “sample rate” is not aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum rate of any single channel.

text.zh: 4. 对于多通道“电子组件”、模块或设备中的交织通道，各“采样率”累加，以所有交织通道合计的最大总速率为“采样率”。
text.en: 4. For interleaved channels on multiple-channel “electronic assemblies”, modules, or equipment, the “sample rates” are aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum combined total rate of all the interleaved channels.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A002.h包括ADC卡、波形数字化仪、数据采集卡、信号采集板及瞬态记录仪。
text.en: 3A002.h includes ADC cards, waveform digitizers, data acquisition cards, signal acquisition boards and transient recorders.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 具有一个或多个数字处理单元且符合以下任一条件的集成电路：
text.en: a. Integrated circuits having one or more digital processing units having either of the following:

text.zh: a.1. “总处理性能”为4800或以上；或
text.en: a.1. A 'total processing performance' of 4800 or more; or

text.zh: a.2. “总处理性能”为1600或以上且“性能密度”为5.92或以上。
text.en: a.2. A 'total processing performance' of 1600 or more and a 'performance density' of 5.92 or more.
Note 1 to 3A090.a:

text.zh: 当“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司拟出口、再出口或境内转移“适用的先进逻辑集成电路”时，推定该物项属于3A090.a并且为数据中心设计或销售。如果“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司无法推翻该推定，则必须遵守适用于3A090.a所列物项的所有许可要求。但该推定不适用于“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司之外的任何实体。“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可通过本注1第a至c段所列三种方式中的任一种推翻该推定。
text.en: When a “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company is seeking to export, reexport, or transfer (in-country) an “applicable advanced logic integrated circuit,” there is a presumption that the item is 3A090.a and designed or marketed for datacenters. If the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company cannot overcome this presumption, then it must comply with all license requirements applicable to items specified in 3A090.a. However, this presumption does not apply to any entity other than the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company. A “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company can overcome this presumption in any of the following three ways outlined in paragraphs a. through c. of this Note 1.

text.zh: a. 如果“适用的先进逻辑集成电路”的设计商是经批准或获授权的集成电路设计商，则由该经批准或获授权的集成电路设计商提供、注明“总处理性能”和“性能密度”且表明该IC不属于3A090.a的数据表或其他证明，即可推翻对“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司适用的该IC属于ECCN 3A090.a的推定。
text.en: a. If the designer of the “applicable advanced logic integrated circuit” is an approved or authorized integrated circuit designer, then a datasheet or other attestation of the 'total processing performance' and the 'performance density' from the approved or authorized integrated circuit designer indicating that the IC is not specified in 3A090.a will overcome the presumption for the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company that the IC is specified in ECCN 3A090.a.

text.zh: (1) 经批准的集成电路设计商列于EAR本部分附录6；
text.en: (1) Approved integrated circuit designers are listed in supplement no. 6 to this part of the EAR;

text.zh: (2) 2026年12月31日之前，获授权的集成电路设计商包括符合以下条件的所有集成电路设计商：
text.en: (2) Prior to December 31, 2026, authorized integrated circuit designers include all integrated circuit designers:

text.zh: (i) 总部设在台湾或A:1或A:5国家组所列目的地，且其自身不位于澳门或EAR第740部分附录1中D:5国家组所列目的地，其最终母公司总部也不设于这些地方；以及
text.en: (i) Headquartered in Taiwan or a destination specified in Country Group A:1 or A:5, that are neither located in nor have an ultimate parent headquartered in Macau or a destination specified in Country Group D:5 of supplement no. 1 to part 740 of the EAR; and

text.zh: (ii) 已同意向“前端制造商”提交第743.9(b)条所述适用信息，随后“前端制造商”必须向BIS报告该信息。
text.en: (ii) That have agreed to submit applicable information described in § 743.9(b) to the “front-end fabricator,” which the “front-end fabricator” must then report to BIS.

text.zh: (3) 2026年12月31日之后，获授权的集成电路设计商包括同时满足第(2)项标准并已提交成为经批准的集成电路设计商申请的任何集成电路设计商。但是，在2026年12月31日之后被视为获授权IC设计商的任何公司，将在其提交成为经批准IC设计商的申请180天后不再属于获授权IC设计商。
text.en: (3) After December 31, 2026, authorized integrated circuit designers include any integrated circuit designer that both meets the criteria specified in subparagraph (2) and has submitted an application to become an approved integrated circuit designer. However, any company deemed an authorized IC designer after December 31, 2026, will cease to be an authorized IC designer 180 days after the submission of its application to become an approved IC designer.

text.zh: b. 如果集成电路裸片由“前端制造商”在澳门及第740部分附录1中D:5国家组所列目的地以外的地点进行封装，则该“前端制造商”出具的以下证明可推翻对“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司适用的该IC属于ECCN 3A090.a的推定：(a) 最终封装IC的“合计估算晶体管数量”低于300亿个；或(b) 最终封装IC不含高带宽存储器，且其“合计估算晶体管数量”低于(i) 对2027年完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为350亿个；或(ii) 对2029年或以后完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为400亿个。
text.en: b. If the integrated circuit die is packaged by the “front-end fabricator” at a location outside of Macau or a destination specified in Country Group D:5 in supplement no. 1 to part 740, then the attestation of the “front-end fabricator” that (a) the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below 30 billion transistors, or (b) the final packaged IC does not contain high-bandwidth memory and that the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below (i) 35 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2027; or (ii) 40 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2029 or thereafter, then this overcomes the presumption by the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company that the IC is specified in ECCN 3A090.a.

text.zh: c. 如果集成电路由EAR第740部分附录7所列经批准的“OSAT”公司封装，则该经批准的“OSAT”公司出具的以下证明可推翻对“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司适用的该IC属于ECCN 3A090.a的推定：(a) 最终封装IC的“合计估算晶体管数量”低于300亿个；或(b) 最终封装IC不含高带宽存储器，且其“合计估算晶体管数量”低于(i) 对2027年完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为350亿个；或(ii) 对2029年或以后完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为400亿个。
text.en: c. If the integrated circuit is packaged by an approved “OSAT” company listed in supplement no. 7 to part 740 of the EAR, then the attestation of the approved “OSAT” company that (a) the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below 30 billion transistors, or (b) the final packaged IC does not contain high-bandwidth memory and that the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below (i) 35 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2027; or (ii) 40 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2029 or thereafter, then this overcomes the presumption by the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company that the IC is specified in ECCN 3A090.a.

text.zh: d. 除本注第a至c段所列三种方式之一外，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司仅依赖最终用户或交易其他方的证明来确认ECCN并不足够。在没有EAR第740部分附录6所列经批准的集成电路设计商就“总处理性能”和“性能密度”作出证明的情况下，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司必须推定以下任何逻辑集成电路属于ECCN 3A090.a并为数据中心设计或销售：采用“16/14纳米节点”或以下节点制造，或采用非平面晶体管架构制造，并拟用于符合以下条件的商品：(a) 最终封装IC的“合计估算晶体管数量”低于300亿个；或(b) 最终封装IC不含高带宽存储器，且其“合计估算晶体管数量”低于(i) 对2027年完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为350亿个；或(ii) 对2029年或以后完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为400亿个；或者最终封装集成电路的“合计估算晶体管数量”无法由“前端制造商”或EAR第740部分附录7所列经批准的“OSAT”公司确认。
text.en: d. It is not sufficient for the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company to confirm the ECCN by relying on the attestation of the end user or other party to the transaction, except under one of the three ways enumerated in paragraphs a. through c. of this note. In the absence of an attestation of the 'total processing performance' and the 'performance density' by an approved integrated circuit designer listed in supplement no. 6 to part 740 of the EAR, the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company must presume that any logic integrated circuit produced using the “16/14 nanometer node” or below, or using a non-planar transistor architecture and destined for a commodity with an (a) “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below 30 billion transistors, or (b) the final packaged IC does not contain high-bandwidth memory and that the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below (i) 35 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2027; or (ii) 40 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2029 or thereafter, or where the “aggregated approximated transistor count,” of the final, packaged integrated circuit cannot be confirmed by the “front-end fabricator,” or an approved “OSAT” company listed in supplement no. 7 to part 740 of the EAR, is specified in ECCN 3A090.a and designed or marketed for a datacenter.

text.zh: 3A090.a技术说明1：
text.en: Technical Note 1 to 3A090.a:

text.zh: 裸片的“估算晶体管数量”为该裸片的“晶体管密度”乘以以平方毫米计量的裸片面积。裸片的“晶体管密度”是指采用制造该裸片的工艺节点时每平方毫米可制造的晶体管数。计算裸片的“估算晶体管数量”时，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司有两种选择。第一，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可将制造裸片所用工艺节点的晶体管密度乘以裸片面积。该数值可能明显高于真实晶体管数量，但如果结果低于相关晶体管阈值，则“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可确信该裸片不会超过该阈值。第二，对于临界情况，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可利用标准设计验证工具，依据GDS文件估算裸片上有源和无源晶体管的数量。
text.en: The 'approximated transistor count' of a die is the 'transistor density' of the die multiplied by the area of the die measured in square millimeters. The 'transistor density' of the die is the number of transistors that can be fabricated per square millimeter for the process node used to manufacture the die. To calculate the number of 'approximated transistor count' of a die, a “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company has two options. First, the “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company may take the transistor density of the process node used to manufacture the die and multiply this density by the area of the die. This number may be significantly higher than the true transistor count, but if the result is below the relevant transistor threshold, then the “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company can be confident that the die in question will not exceed that threshold. Second, to adjudicate edge cases, the “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company may use standard design verification tools to estimate the number of (both active and passive) transistors on the die using the GDS file.

text.zh: b. 具有一个或多个数字处理单元且符合以下任一条件的集成电路：
text.en: b. Integrated circuits having one or more digital processing units having either of the following:

text.zh: b.1. “总处理性能”为2400或以上且低于4800，并且“性能密度”为1.6或以上且低于5.92；或
text.en: b.1. A 'total processing performance' of 2400 or more and less than 4800 and a 'performance density' of 1.6 or more and less than 5.92, or

text.zh: b.2. “总处理性能”为1600或以上，并且“性能密度”为3.2或以上且低于5.92。
text.en: b.2. A 'total processing performance' of 1600 or more and a 'performance density' of 3.2 or more and less than 5.92.
Note 2 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 3A090.a及3A090.b不适用于并非为数据中心用途设计或销售且“总处理性能”未达到4800的物项。对于并非为数据中心用途设计或销售且“总处理性能”为4800或以上的3A090.a及3A090.b物项，见许可证例外NAC和ACA。
text.en: 3A090.a and 3A090.b do not apply to items that are not designed or marketed for use in datacenters and do not have a 'total processing performance' of 4800 or more. For 3A090.a and 3A090.b items that are not designed or marketed for use in datacenters and that have a 'total processing performance' of 4800 or more, see license exceptions NAC and ACA.
Note 3 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 3A090所列集成电路包括图形处理单元（GPU）、张量处理单元（TPU）、神经处理器、存内处理器、视觉处理器、文本处理器、协处理器/加速器、自适应处理器、现场可编程逻辑器件（FPLD）和专用集成电路（ASIC）。集成电路示例见3A001.a的注。
text.en: Integrated circuits specified by 3A090 include graphical processing units (GPUs), tensor processing units (TPUs), neural processors, in-memory processors, vision processors, text processors, co-processors/accelerators, adaptive processors, field-programmable logic devices (FPLDs), and application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs). Examples of integrated circuits are in the Note to 3A001.a.
Note 4 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 对于根据3A090注2或注3排除在ECCN 3A090之外的集成电路，也不适用ECCN 3A001.z、4A003.z、4A004.z、4A005.z、4A090、5A002.z、5A004.z、5A992.z、5D002.z或5D992.z项下的分类，因为这些其他CCL分类以含有满足ECCN 3A090管制参数的集成电路，或以其他方式达到或超过ECCN 3A090或4A090的管制参数为依据。ECCN 3A090.c中的性能参数不用于判定物项是否归入某个.z ECCN。见ECCN 3A001.z、4A003.z、4A004.z、4A005.z、4A090、5A002.z、5A004.z、5A992.z、5D002.z或5D992.z的相关管制段落。
text.en: For integrated circuits that are excluded from ECCN 3A090 under Note 2 or 3 to 3A090, those ICs are also not applicable for classifications made under ECCNs 3A001.z, 4A003.z, 4A004.z, 4A005.z, 4A090, 5A002.z, 5A004.z, 5A992.z, 5D002.z, or 5D992.z because those other CCL classifications are based on the incorporation of an integrated circuit that meets the control parameters under ECCN 3A090 or otherwise meets or exceeds the control parameters or ECCNs 3A090 or 4A090. The performance parameters under ECCN 3A090.c are not used for determining whether an item is classified in a .z ECCN. See the Related Controls paragraphs of ECCNs 3A001.z, 4A003.z, 4A004.z, 4A005.z, 4A090, 5A002.z, 5A004.z, 5A992.z, 5D002.z, or 5D992.z.

text.zh: 3A090.a及3A090.b技术说明2：
text.en: Technical Note 2 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 1. “总处理性能”（“TPP”）为2 × “MacTOPS” × “运算位长”，并对集成电路上的所有处理单元求和。
text.en: 1. 'Total processing performance' ('TPP') is 2 × 'MacTOPS' × 'bit length of the operation', aggregated over all processing units on the integrated circuit.

text.zh: a. 在3A090中，“MacTOPS”是乘累加运算（D = A × B + C）每秒万亿（10^{12}）次运算的理论峰值。
text.en: a. For purposes of 3A090, 'MacTOPS' is the theoretical peak number of Tera (10^{12}) operations per second for multiply-accumulate computation (D = A × B + C).

text.zh: b. “TPP”公式中的2基于行业惯例：在数据表中，将一次乘累加运算D = A × B + C计为2次运算。因此，2 × MacTOPS可对应于数据表报告的TOPS或FLOPS。
text.en: b. The 2 in the 'TPP' formula is based on industry convention of counting one multiply-accumulate computation, D = A × B + C, as 2 operations for purpose of datasheets. Therefore, 2 × MacTOPS may correspond to the reported TOPS or FLOPS on a datasheet.

text.zh: c. 在3A090中，乘累加运算的“运算位长”为乘法运算输入值中的最大位长。
text.en: c. For purposes of 3A090, 'bit length of the operation' for a multiply-accumulate computation is the largest bit-length of the inputs to the multiply operation.

text.zh: d. 将集成电路上各处理单元的TPP相加得到总值。“TPP” = TPP1 + TPP2 + . . . . + TPPn（其中n为集成电路上的处理单元数量）。
text.en: d. Aggregate the TPPs for each processing unit on the integrated circuit to arrive at a total. 'TPP' = TPP1 + TPP2 + . . . . + TPPn (where n is the number or processing units on the integrated circuit).

text.zh: 2. “MacTOPS”速率应按理论上可能达到的最大值计算。“MacTOPS”速率假定为制造商在该集成电路年报或宣传册中声称的最高值。例如，8位下每秒600万亿次整数运算（或2 × 300 “MacTOPS”）或16位下每秒300万亿次浮点运算（或2 × 150 “MacTOPS”）均可达到4800的“TPP”阈值。如果集成电路设计用于多种位长的MAC运算，并可获得不同“TPP”值，则应以最高“TPP”值对照3A090的参数评估。
text.en: 2. The rate of 'MacTOPS' is to be calculated at its maximum value theoretically possible. The rate of 'MacTOPS' is assumed to be the highest value the manufacturer claims in annual or brochure for the integrated circuit. For example, the 'TPP' threshold of 4800 can be met with 600 tera integer operations (or 2 × 300 'MacTOPS') at 8 bits or 300 tera FLOPS (or 2 × 150 'MacTOPS') at 16 bits. If the integrated circuit is designed for MAC computation with multiple bit lengths that achieve different 'TPP' values, the highest 'TPP' value should be evaluated against parameters in 3A090.

text.zh: 3. 对于同时支持稀疏矩阵和稠密矩阵处理的3A090所列集成电路，“TPP”值为处理稠密矩阵时的数值（即不使用稀疏性）。
text.en: 3. For integrated circuits specified by 3A090 that provide processing of both sparse and dense matrices, the 'TPP' values are the values for processing of dense matrices (e.g., without sparsity).

text.zh: 4. “性能密度”为“TPP”除以“适用裸片面积”。在3A090中，“适用裸片面积”以平方毫米计量，包括采用非平面晶体管架构工艺节点制造的所有逻辑裸片的全部面积。
text.en: 4. 'Performance density' is 'TPP' divided by 'applicable die area'. For purposes of 3A090, 'applicable die area' is measured in millimeters squared and includes all die area of logic dies manufactured with a process node that uses a non-planar transistor architecture.

text.zh: c. “存储器带宽密度”大于每平方毫米每秒2吉字节的高带宽存储器（HBM）。
text.en: c. High bandwidth memory (HBM) having a 'memory bandwidth density' greater than 2 gigabytes per second per square millimeter.

text.zh: 3A090.c技术说明1：
text.en: Technical Note 1 to 3A090.c:

text.zh: “存储器带宽密度”为以吉字节每秒计量的存储器带宽，除以以平方毫米计量的封装或堆叠面积。如果堆叠包含在一个封装内，则使用封装器件的存储器带宽和封装面积。高带宽存储器（HBM）包括动态随机存取存储器集成电路，无论其是否符合JEDEC高带宽存储器（HBM）标准，只要其“存储器带宽密度”大于每平方毫米每秒2吉字节。本管制不涵盖同时包含HBM和逻辑集成电路、且主导功能为处理的共封装集成电路。本管制包括永久附着在逻辑集成电路上的HBM，该逻辑集成电路设计用作控制接口并具有物理层（PHY）功能。
text.en: 'Memory bandwidth density' is the memory bandwidth measured in gigabytes per second divided by the area of the package or stack measured in square millimeters. In the case where a stack is contained in a package, use the memory bandwidth of the packaged device and the area of the package. High bandwidth memory (HBM) includes dynamic random access memory integrated circuits, regardless of whether they conform to the JEDEC standards for high bandwidth memory (HBM), provided they have a 'memory bandwidth density' greater than 2 gigabytes per second per square millimeter. This control does not cover co-packaged integrated circuits with both HBM and logic integrated circuit where the dominant function of the co-packaged integrated circuit is processing. It does include HBM permanently affixed to a logic integrated circuit designed as a control interface and incorporating a physical layer (PHY) function.

text.en: a.2.a.1. Rated for operation in the temperature range from below −54 °C to above +125 °C; and

text.zh: a.2.a.2. 气密封装；或

text.zh: a.2.b. 同时具有以下所有特性的电输入型模数转换器印刷电路板或模块：

text.zh: a.2.b.1. 额定工作温度范围从低于−45 °C到高于+80 °C；以及
text.en: a.2.b.1. Rated for operation in the temperature range from below −45 °C to above +80 °C; and

text.zh: a.2.b.2. 装有3A101.a.2 .a所列微电路；
text.en: a.2.b.2. Incorporating microcircuits identified in 3A101.a.2 .a;

text.zh: b. 能够利用能量为2 MeV或以上的加速电子产生轫致辐射电磁辐射、且可用于“导弹”或“导弹”子系统的加速器，以及含有此类加速器的系统。
text.en: b. Accelerators capable of delivering electromagnetic radiation produced by bremsstrahlung from accelerated electrons of 2 MeV or greater, and systems containing those accelerators, usable for the “missiles” or the subsystems of “missiles”.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 上述3A101.b不包括为医疗用途“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: 3A101.b above does not include equipment “specially designed” for medical purposes.

text.zh: 物项：a. 具有以下任一组特性的脉冲放电电容器：
text.en: Items: a. Pulse discharge capacitors having either of the following sets of characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 额定电压大于1.4 kV、储能大于10 J、电容大于0.5 µF且串联电感小于50 nH；或
text.en: a.1. Voltage rating greater than 1.4 kV, energy storage greater than 10 J, capacitance greater than 0.5 µF, and series inductance less than 50 nH; or

text.zh: a.2. 额定电压大于750 V、电容大于0.25 µF且串联电感小于10 nH；
text.en: a.2. Voltage rating greater than 750 V, capacitance greater than 0.25 µF, and series inductance less than 10 nH;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下所有特性的超导螺线管电磁铁：
text.en: b. Superconducting solenoidal electromagnets having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 能产生大于2 T的磁场；
text.en: b.1. Capable of creating magnetic fields greater than 2 T;

text.zh: b.2. 长度与内径之比大于2；
text.en: b.2. A ratio of length to inner diameter greater than 2;

text.zh: b.3. 内径大于300 mm；以及
text.en: b.3. Inner diameter greater than 300 mm; and

text.zh: b.4. 在内部容积中央50%范围内，磁场均匀性优于1%；
text.en: b.4. Magnetic field uniform to better than 1% over the central 50% of the inner volume;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A201.b不管制为医用核磁共振（NMR）成像系统“专门设计”并“作为其零件”出口的磁体。“作为其零件”不一定是指同一批货物中的实体零件；允许由不同来源分批装运，但相关出口文件须明确表明各批货物“作为”该成像系统的“一部分”发运。
text.en: 3A201.b does not control magnets “specially designed” for and exported “as parts of” medical nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) imaging systems. The phrase “as part of” does not necessarily mean physical part in the same shipment; separate shipments from different sources are allowed, provided the related export documents clearly specify that the shipments are dispatched “as part of” the imaging systems.

text.zh: c. 具有以下任一组特性的闪光X射线发生器或脉冲电子加速器：
text.en: c. Flash X-ray generators or pulsed electron accelerators having either of the following sets of characteristics:

text.zh: c.1. 加速器电子峰值能量为500 keV或以上但低于25 MeV，且“品质因数”（K）为0.25或以上；或
text.en: c.1. An accelerator peak electron energy of 500 keV or greater, but less than 25 MeV, and with a “figure of merit” (K) of 0.25 or greater; or

text.zh: c.2. 加速器电子峰值能量为25 MeV或以上，且“峰值功率”大于50 MW；
text.en: c.2. An accelerator peak electron energy of 25 MeV or greater, and a “peak power” greater than 50 MW;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A201.c不管制作为非电子束或X射线辐射用途（例如电子显微镜）设计的器件的“零件”或“部件”的加速器，也不管制为医疗用途设计的加速器。
text.en: 3A201.c does not control accelerators that are “parts” or “components” of devices designed for purposes other than electron beam or X-ray radiation (electron microscopy, for example) nor those designed for medical purposes.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: (1) “品质因数”K定义为：K = 1.7 × 10^{3}V ^{2.65}Q。V为以百万电子伏特计的电子峰值能量。如果加速器束流脉冲持续时间小于或等于1 µs，则Q为以库仑计的总加速电荷。如果加速器束流脉冲持续时间大于1 µs，则Q为1 µs内的最大加速电荷。Q等于在1 µs或束流脉冲持续时间两者较小值内对i关于t积分，Q= ∫ idt)，其中i为以安培计的束流电流，t为以秒计的时间。
text.en: (1) The “figure of merit” K is defined as: K = 1.7 × 10^{3}V ^{2.65}Q. V is the peak electron energy in million electron volts. If the accelerator beam pulse duration is less than or equal to 1 µs, then Q is the total accelerated charge in Coulombs. If the accelerator beam pulse duration is greater than 1 µs, then Q is the maximum accelerated charge in 1 µs. Q equals the intergral of i with respect to t, over the lesser of 1 µs or the time duration of the beam pulse Q= ∫ idt), where i is beam current in amperes and t is time in seconds.

text.zh: (2) “峰值功率” = （以伏特计的峰值电势） × （以安培计的峰值束流电流）。
text.en: (2) “Peak power” = (peak potential in volts) × (peak beam current in amperes).

text.zh: (3) 在基于微波加速腔的机器中，束流脉冲持续时间为1 µs或一个微波调制器脉冲产生的聚束束流包持续时间两者中的较小值。
text.en: (3) In machines based on microwave accelerating cavities, the time duration of the beam pulse is the lesser of 1 µs or the duration of the bunched beam packet resulting from one microwave modulator pulse.

text.zh: (4) 在基于微波加速腔的机器中，峰值束流电流为一个聚束束流包持续时间内的平均电流。
text.en: (4) In machines based on microwave accelerating cavities, the peak beam current is the average current in the time duration of a bunched beam packet.
